passage: Camels can travel for days without drinking water. ______ when water is available, a thirsty camel can drink more than 100 liters in just a few minutes.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Ikkinchi gap tuyalar haqida yana bir hayratlanarli fakt qo'shadi. "Moreover" — bundan tashqari.
explanation_en: The second sentence adds another striking fact: "Moreover."

passage: The first version of the school's app was slow and difficult to navigate. ______ the student developers rebuilt it from scratch, and the second version was praised for its speed.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Birinchi versiya yomon edi → shuning uchun qaytadan yozildi. Natija: "Consequently".
explanation_en: The poor first version caused the rebuild: "Consequently."

passage: Some historians argue that the printing press spread literacy rapidly. Others point out that, for decades after its invention, printed books remained too expensive for most people to buy. ______ the full effect of the printing press on literacy may have taken generations to appear.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Kitoblar uzoq vaqt qimmat bo'lgan → demak ta'sir avlodlar o'tib ko'ringan. Xulosa: "Thus".
explanation_en: Because books stayed expensive, the effect took generations: a conclusion, "Thus."

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Itchan Kala is the walled inner town of Khiva, in Uzbekistan.
• Its brick walls are about 10 meters high.
• It contains more than 50 historic monuments.
• Itchan Kala was added to the UNESCO World Heritage List in 1990.
stem: The student wants to indicate when Itchan Kala received international recognition. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Itchan Kala's brick walls are about 10 meters high.
Itchan Kala contains more than 50 historic monuments.
Itchan Kala, the walled inner town of Khiva, was added to the UNESCO World Heritage List in 1990.
Itchan Kala is the walled inner town of Khiva.
explanation_uz: Maqsad — xalqaro e'tirof qachon bo'lganini ko'rsatish. C YuNESKO ro'yxatiga kiritilgan yilni (1990) aytadi.
explanation_en: Only C gives when it was recognized: UNESCO, 1990.

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The Riverside Bridge opened in 1968.
• It is 450 meters long and made of steel.
• The Harbor Bridge opened in 2015.
• It is 1,200 meters long and made of concrete.
stem: The student wants to emphasize a difference in length between the two bridges. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: The Riverside Bridge opened in 1968, and the Harbor Bridge opened in 2015.
The Riverside Bridge is made of steel, while the Harbor Bridge is made of concrete.
The Harbor Bridge, which opened in 2015, is made of concrete.
At 1,200 meters, the Harbor Bridge is nearly three times as long as the 450-meter Riverside Bridge.
explanation_uz: Maqsad — uzunlikdagi farq. D ikkala ko'prik uzunligini solishtiradi (1 200 m va 450 m).
explanation_en: Only D compares the lengths (1,200 m vs. 450 m).

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Researchers wanted to learn how roads affect forest animals.
• They placed motion-activated cameras at 40 sites in a forest.
• The cameras recorded animals for one full year.
• Foxes were more active at night near roads than far from them.
stem: The student wants to describe the study's method. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Foxes were more active at night near roads than far from them.
To study how roads affect forest animals, researchers placed motion-activated cameras at 40 forest sites and recorded footage for a year.
Researchers wanted to learn how roads affect forest animals.
Roads may change when forest animals such as foxes are active.
explanation_uz: Usul — tadqiqot QANDAY o'tkazilgani: 40 joyga kamera qo'yilgan, bir yil yozib olingan. Bu B. A — natija, D — xulosa.
explanation_en: The method is how the study was done: cameras at 40 sites for a year. A is a finding; D is a conclusion.

passage: The senator's speech was notably ______: she avoided taking any position on the proposal, choosing instead to praise the hard work of everyone involved.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Hech qanday pozitsiya bildirmagan — "noncommittal" (aniq fikr bildirmaydigan).
explanation_en: She avoided taking a position: "noncommittal."

passage: Rather than ______ the gaps in the historical record with guesswork, the biographer chose to tell readers plainly where the evidence ran out.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Biograf bo'shliqlarni ochiq aytgan — taxmin bilan "yopib ketish" (paper over) o'rniga.
explanation_en: Instead of hiding the gaps with guesses ("paper over"), the biographer admitted them.

passage: Initially ______ about the new drip-irrigation method, the farmers changed their minds after seeing their neighbors' cotton harvests nearly double.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Keyin fikrini o'zgartirgan — demak avval shubhada bo'lgan: "skeptical".
explanation_en: They later changed their minds, so at first they doubted it: "skeptical."

passage: The new evidence does not so much ______ the theory as complicate it, raising questions that the theory's supporters had not considered.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: "not so much X as complicate" — nazariyani rad etmaydi, balki murakkablashtiradi: "refute".
explanation_en: It complicates the theory rather than disproving it: "refute."

passage: Beside a 2,000-year-old ceramic bowl in a glass case, the museum's new exhibit displays an exact 3D-printed copy. Visitors are not allowed to touch the original, which is too fragile, but they are encouraged to pick up the copy, feel its weight, and run their fingers along the grooves left by the potter's tools.
stem: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
choices: To argue that 3D-printed copies are more valuable than original artifacts
To explain how ancient potters made ceramic bowls
To criticize museums for keeping artifacts behind glass
To describe how an exhibit lets visitors experience an artifact in a way that would otherwise be impossible
explanation_uz: Asl idishni ushlab bo'lmaydi, nusxasini esa ushlash mumkin — ko'rgazma boshqacha imkonsiz tajribani beradi.
explanation_en: The copy lets visitors touch what they couldn't touch otherwise.

passage: Many cities plant trees along streets to keep neighborhoods cool. Trees release water vapor through tiny pores in their leaves, and as this water evaporates, it draws heat from the surrounding air. In one study, streets with full tree cover were up to 5°C cooler on summer afternoons than nearby streets without trees.
stem: Which choice best describes the function of the second sentence in the overall structure of the text?
choices: It introduces a claim that the third sentence later rejects.
It describes the results of the study mentioned in the third sentence.
It explains the process behind the cooling effect mentioned in the first sentence.
It offers an example of a city that plants trees.
explanation_uz: 1-gap: daraxtlar salqin qiladi. 2-gap: QANDAY — barglardan bug'lanish issiqlikni oladi. Ya'ni jarayonni tushuntiradi.
explanation_en: Sentence 2 explains how trees cool the air (evaporation), the effect named in sentence 1.

passage:
Text 1
Language researcher Kamila Rashidova argues that a second language must be learned in childhood. Adults, she claims, can memorize vocabulary but almost never reach true fluency, and they nearly always keep a noticeable accent.

Text 2
In a study of 300 adults who began learning English after age twenty, many reached scores on grammar and vocabulary tests that matched those of native speakers. Most participants, however, still had accents that listeners could detect.
stem: Based on the texts, on which point would the author of Text 2 most likely agree with Rashidova?
choices: Adults cannot learn grammar as well as children can.
Age may affect some aspects of language learning, such as accent.
Vocabulary is the most difficult part of a language to learn.
Studies of adult learners are unreliable.
explanation_uz: 2-matn grammatika va lug'at bo'yicha Rashidovaga qarshi chiqadi, lekin aksent saqlanib qolishini tasdiqlaydi. Umumiy nuqta — aksent.
explanation_en: Text 2 disagrees about grammar and vocabulary but confirms accents remain: they agree on accent.

passage: Scholars long assumed that a medieval trade route through the Pamir Mountains was used only in summer, when the passes were free of snow. Recently translated letters, however, describe merchants hiring local guides to lead caravans of silk and spices through deep snow in January. The letters suggest that, at least for valuable goods, winter crossings were difficult but not unusual.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
choices: Medieval merchants preferred to travel in winter because the routes were less crowded.
Local guides in the Pamir Mountains were paid more than merchants.
New evidence indicates that merchants sometimes used the mountain route in winter, contrary to earlier assumptions.
Silk and spices were the only goods carried on the mountain route.
explanation_uz: Avvalgi taxmin: faqat yozda. Yangi xatlar: qishda ham qatnashgan. Asosiy fikr — yangi dalil eski taxminni o'zgartiradi.
explanation_en: Letters show winter crossings, overturning the summer-only assumption.

passage: To study how expertise affects memory, a team of psychologists chose to work with chess players. They explained that chess positions can be described with complete precision, which makes it easy to check exactly what a player remembers. In addition, every competitive player has an official rating, so the researchers could compare players' skill levels objectively.
stem: According to the text, why did the researchers choose to study chess players?
choices: Because chess is the most popular game among psychologists
Because chess players have better memories than other people
Because the researchers were chess players themselves
Because players' skill levels are officially recorded and easy to compare
explanation_uz: Matnda ikki sabab bor: pozitsiyalarni aniq tasvirlash mumkin va har bir o'yinchining rasmiy reytingi bor. D ikkinchisini aytadi.
explanation_en: The text says official ratings let researchers compare skill objectively.

passage: In the novel Winter Orchard, the narrator, a young student, gradually comes to admire her strict piano teacher.
stem: Which quotation from Winter Orchard most effectively illustrates this change in the narrator's feelings?
choices: "Her apartment smelled of black tea and old sheet music."
"At first I counted the minutes until each lesson ended; by spring I found myself repeating her advice to my younger sister."
"She never once told me that I had played well."
"The piano had belonged to her grandfather, and two of its keys stuck."
explanation_uz: Da'vo — asta-sekin O'ZGARISH. B ham avvalgi holatni (daqiqalarni sanagan), ham keyingisini (maslahatini takrorlagan) ko'rsatadi.
explanation_en: The claim is about a gradual change; B shows the before and the after.

passage: A city official claims that the new bicycle lanes built in 2022 caused the decrease in traffic accidents that the city recorded in 2023.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the official's claim?
choices: The new bicycle lanes were used by more than 5,000 cyclists per day in 2023.
Accidents involving bicycles were less common than accidents involving only cars.
Traffic accidents decreased by about the same percentage in neighboring cities that built no new bicycle lanes during the same period.
Most residents said they felt safer cycling after the lanes were built.
explanation_uz: Yo'lak qurmagan qo'shni shaharlarda ham baxtsiz hodisalar xuddi shunday kamaygan bo'lsa, sabab yo'laklar emas, boshqa narsa bo'lishi mumkin.
explanation_en: If cities without new lanes saw the same drop, something else likely caused it.

passage:
Share of electricity from renewable sources

Country P — 2015: 12% — 2023: 31%
Country Q — 2015: 25% — 2023: 29%
Country R — 2015: 8% — 2023: 22%

An energy researcher claims that among the three countries, Country P had the largest increase in its share of electricity from renewable sources between 2015 and 2023.
stem: Which choice best uses data from the table to support the researcher's claim?
choices: Country Q had the highest share of renewable electricity in 2015.
All three countries increased their share of renewable electricity.
Country P's share rose by 19 percentage points, from 12% to 31%, compared with increases of 4 points for Country Q and 14 points for Country R.
explanation_uz: "Eng katta o'sish"ni isbotlash uchun uchala davlatning o'sishini solishtirish kerak: P +19, Q +4, R +14.
explanation_en: "Largest increase" requires comparing all three: +19, +4, +14.

passage:
Average quiz score by nightly sleep

Less than 6 hours — 71
6 to 8 hours — 78
8 hours or more — 84

A health teacher surveyed students about their sleep and compared the results with their scores on a weekly quiz. The data show that ______
stem: Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
choices: average quiz scores were highest, at 84, among students who slept 8 hours or more.
students who slept less than 6 hours scored 78 on average.
most students slept between 6 and 8 hours.
no student scored below 71 on the quiz.
explanation_uz: Jadvalda faqat o'rtacha ballar bor. A to'g'ri o'qiydi (84 — eng yuqori). B noto'g'ri raqam, C va D jadvalda yo'q ma'lumot.
explanation_en: A correctly reads the table; B misreads it, and C and D aren't supported by averages.

passage: Tadpoles of a certain frog species grow unusually large tails when they live in ponds that contain predatory fish; larger tails help them swim away quickly. In a laboratory experiment, researchers raised tadpoles in water that had previously held predatory fish but from which the fish had been removed. These tadpoles also grew larger tails. This suggests that ______
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
choices: the tadpoles grew larger tails because they saw the fish.
the tadpoles can detect chemical cues left in the water by fish and respond by growing larger tails.
tail size in tadpoles is not affected by their environment.
predatory fish prefer to eat tadpoles with small tails.
explanation_uz: Baliqlar yo'q edi, demak itbaliqlar ularni ko'rmagan. Lekin suvda baliqlardan iz qolgan — itbaliqlar kimyoviy signalni sezgan.
explanation_en: The fish were gone, so the tadpoles couldn't see them; they must have sensed something left in the water.

passage: The festival's organizers expected about 5,000 ______ more than 12,000 people attended over the three days.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ikki mustaqil gap: nuqtali vergul ularni ajratadi, "instead" dan keyin vergul qo'yiladi.
explanation_en: Two independent clauses take a semicolon, with a comma after the transition "instead."

passage: Uzbek poet ______ published her first collection at the age of nineteen.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ism qaysi shoir ekanini aniqlaydi (zarur ma'lumot), shuning uchun tinish belgisiz yoziladi.
explanation_en: The name identifies which poet, so no punctuation is used.

passage: In 2021, the student team completed its first major ______ a small satellite designed to monitor crop health from orbit.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ikki nuqta "project" nima ekanini tushuntiradi. Nuqtali vergul ortidan to'liq gap kerak — bu yerda yo'q.
explanation_en: A colon introduces what the project was; a semicolon would need a full clause after it.

passage: Some of the oldest known cave ______ found on the island of Sulawesi in Indonesia, depict wild pigs.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Izoh vergul bilan tugaydi ("Indonesia,"), demak vergul bilan boshlanishi ham kerak.
explanation_en: The clause ends with a comma, so it must begin with a comma.

passage: Neither the coach nor the players ______ satisfied with the draw, but both agreed it was a fair result.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: "Neither ... nor" da fe'l yaqinroq egaga moslashadi: "the players" (ko'plik) → were.
explanation_en: With "neither ... nor," the verb agrees with the nearer subject, "players": "were."

passage: The measurements that the team collected over three summers ______ that the glacier is retreating faster than earlier models predicted.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ega — "The measurements" (ko'plik), "summers" emas. Fe'l: suggest.
explanation_en: The subject is "measurements" (plural), so "suggest."

passage: When Dilnoza met with her research advisor last week, ______ suggested several journals that might publish the paper.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: "She" noaniq — Dilnozami yoki maslahatchimi? Aniq ism kerak: "her advisor".
explanation_en: "She" is ambiguous (Dilnoza or the advisor?), so name the person: "her advisor."

passage: Wind turbines generate electricity only when the wind is blowing. ______ many power companies pair them with large batteries that store extra energy for calm days.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Turbina faqat shamol bo'lganda ishlaydi → shuning uchun batareyalar ishlatiladi. "For this reason".
explanation_en: Batteries are used because turbines need wind: "For this reason."

passage: The researchers expected the drug to lower blood pressure in all patients. ______ it had no measurable effect on patients over the age of seventy.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Kutilgan: hammada pasaytiradi. Natija: 70+ yoshlilarda ta'sir yo'q. Zidlik: "However".
explanation_en: The result contradicts the expectation: "However."

passage: The ancient city was abandoned in the fourth century after a series of earthquakes. ______ its location was forgotten, until a farmer plowing his field uncovered part of its wall in 1893.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Shahar tashlab ketilgan → asrlar o'tib joyi unutilgan. Vaqt o'tishini "Over time" bildiradi.
explanation_en: The location was gradually forgotten: "Over time."

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Suzani is a type of embroidered textile from Central Asia.
• Suzanis were traditionally made by women as part of a bride's dowry.
• They often feature large circular motifs representing flowers or the sun.
• They are stitched with silk or cotton thread on cotton cloth.
stem: The student wants to describe a key visual feature of suzanis to an audience unfamiliar with them. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Suzanis were traditionally made by women as part of a bride's dowry.
Suzanis are stitched with silk or cotton thread.
Suzani, a type of embroidered textile from Central Asia, often features large circular motifs representing flowers or the sun.
Many suzanis come from Central Asia.
explanation_uz: Maqsad — ko'rinishdagi asosiy xususiyat + notanish auditoriya. C nima ekanini (Markaziy Osiyo kashtasi) va ko'rinishini (katta doira naqshlar) aytadi.
explanation_en: C explains what a suzani is and its visual feature (large circular motifs).

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• African elephants and Asian elephants are two different species.
• African elephants have much larger ears than Asian elephants.
• Both species live in family groups led by an older female.
• Asian elephants are generally smaller than African elephants.
stem: The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two species. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: African elephants have much larger ears than Asian elephants do.
Both African and Asian elephants live in family groups led by an older female.
Asian elephants are generally smaller than African elephants.
African elephants and Asian elephants are two different species.
explanation_uz: Maqsad — o'xshashlik. Faqat B ikkala turda ham bir xil bo'lgan xususiyatni aytadi.
explanation_en: Only B states something both species share.

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The dutar is a two-stringed instrument from Central Asia with a long neck.
• The tanbur is a Central Asian string instrument with a long neck and frets.
• Instruments of this kind are called long-necked lutes.
• The rubab, by contrast, has a shorter neck.
stem: The student wants to make a generalization about Central Asian string instruments. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: The rubab has a shorter neck than the tanbur.
The tanbur has frets along its neck.
Several Central Asian string instruments, including the dutar and the tanbur, are long-necked lutes.
explanation_uz: Umumlashtirish — bir nechta cholg'u haqida umumiy xulosa. D shuni qiladi, qolganlari bitta cholg'u haqida.
explanation_en: A generalization covers several instruments; D does, while the others describe just one.

stem: If x/4 + 3 = 8, what is the value of x?
explanation_uz: 3 ni ayiramiz: x/4 = 5, keyin 4 ga ko'paytiramiz: x = 20.

stem: Which of the following points lies on the line y = 2x − 1?
explanation_uz: x = 2 da y = 2·2 − 1 = 3, demak (2, 3) chiziqda yotadi.
explanation_en: When x = 2, y = 3, so (2, 3) is on the line.

stem: If 7 − 2x = −9, what is the value of x?
A gym membership costs $35 per month. Aziz has $300 to spend on the membership. What is the greatest number of full months he can pay for?
explanation_uz: 35m ≤ 300 → m ≤ 8.57. Butun oylar soni: 8.
explanation_en: 35m ≤ 300 gives m ≤ 8.57, so 8 full months.

stem: Line k has a slope of 3 and passes through the point (2, 1). Which equation defines line k?
explanation_uz: y − 1 = 3(x − 2) → y = 3x − 5. Tekshiruv: x = 2 da y = 1 ✓.
explanation_en: y − 1 = 3(x − 2) gives y = 3x − 5.

stem:
4x + 3y = 25
y = 2x − 5

What is the value of x in the solution to the system of equations above?
explanation_en: Substitute: 10x − 15 = 25, so x = 4.

stem: Which equation defines a line that passes through the origin and is perpendicular to the line y = −(1/2)x + 4?
explanation_uz: Perpendikulyar chiziqning qiyaligi — teskari va qarama-qarshi ishorali: −1/2 → 2. Koordinata boshidan o'tadi: y = 2x.
explanation_en: Perpendicular slope is the negative reciprocal of −1/2, which is 2; through the origin: y = 2x.

stem: A workshop's total cost of producing n bags is 1,200 + 8n dollars. Each bag sells for $20. What is the least number of bags the workshop must sell to make a profit?
explanation_uz: Foyda: 20n > 1 200 + 8n → 12n > 1 200 → n > 100. Eng kichik butun son: 101. (100 da foyda 0.)
explanation_en: 20n > 1,200 + 8n gives n > 100, so the least whole number is 101 (at 100, profit is zero).

stem: Which expression is equivalent to (x + 5)(x − 2)?
explanation_en: Expand: x² − 2x + 5x − 10 = x² + 3x − 10.

stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = x² − 4x + 7. What is the value of f(3)?
If 3^(x + 1) = 81, what is the value of x?
explanation_en: 81 = 3⁴, so x + 1 = 4 and x = 3.

stem: What is the sum of the solutions to the equation (x − 3)² = 16?
explanation_uz: x − 3 = 4 yoki x − 3 = −4 → x = 7 yoki x = −1. Yig'indi: 6.
explanation_en: x − 3 = ±4, so x = 7 or −1; the sum is 6.

stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = 2(x − 3)² + 5. What are the coordinates of the vertex of the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane?
explanation_uz: a(x − h)² + k ko'rinishida uch (h, k) = (3, 5).
explanation_en: In a(x − h)² + k form, the vertex is (h, k) = (3, 5).

stem: If x > 0 and x² − 2x − 24 = 0, what is the value of x?
explanation_uz: (x − 6)(x + 4) = 0 → x = 6 yoki −4. Musbati 6.
explanation_en: (x − 6)(x + 4) = 0; the positive solution is 6.

stem: Which expression is equivalent to (4x³y²)/(2xy), where x ≠ 0 and y ≠ 0?
explanation_uz: 4/2 = 2, x³/x = x², y²/y = y → 2x²y.
explanation_en: 4/2 = 2, x³/x = x², y²/y = y: 2x²y.

stem: A store sells 3 notebooks for $4.50. At this rate, what is the price of 7 notebooks?
explanation_uz: Bitta daftar: 4.50 / 3 = 1.50. Yettitasi: 7 · 1.50 = 10.50.
explanation_en: One notebook costs $1.50; 7 cost $10.50.

stem: What is the median of the data set 3, 9, 4, 12, 7, 5?
explanation_uz: Tartiblaymiz: 3, 4, 5, 7, 9, 12. Juft son elementlar — o'rtadagi ikkitasining o'rtachasi: (5 + 7) / 2 = 6.

stem: A jacket originally priced at $80 is discounted by 20%. A sales tax of 10% is then applied to the discounted price. What is the final price, in dollars?
The equation F = 1.8C + 32 converts a temperature in degrees Celsius, C, to degrees Fahrenheit, F. What is 25 degrees Celsius in degrees Fahrenheit?
Two angles of a triangle measure 50° and 60°. What is the measure of the third angle?
A right circular cylinder has a radius of 2 and a height of 10. The volume of the cylinder is kπ. What is the value of k?
explanation_uz: V = πr²h = π · 4 · 10 = 40π, demak k = 40.

stem: In a right triangle, one acute angle measures x°, and sin(x°) = 0.6. What is the value of cos((90 − x)°)?
explanation_uz: Qo'shimcha burchaklar uchun cos(90° − x) = sin x. Demak javob 0.6.
explanation_en: cos(90° − x) = sin x = 0.6.

stem: If 2a + 3 = 11, what is the value of 6a + 9?
explanation_uz: 6a + 9 = 3(2a + 3) = 3 · 11 = 33. a ni topish shart emas.

stem:
x + 2y = 10
3x − 2y = 6

If (x, y) is the solution to the system above, what is the value of y?
explanation_uz: Qo'shamiz: 4x = 16 → x = 4. Keyin 4 + 2y = 10 → y = 3.
explanation_en: Add: 4x = 16, x = 4; then 2y = 6, y = 3.

stem: Which of the following systems of equations has no solution?
explanation_uz: Yechim yo'q — qiyaliklar teng, ozod hadlar har xil (parallel chiziqlar). D: ikkalasida qiyalik 2, ozod had 1 va −3. C esa bitta chiziq (cheksiz yechim).
explanation_en: No solution means equal slopes and different intercepts: D. C is the same line (infinitely many solutions).

stem: A water tank contains 500 liters and drains at a constant rate of 12 liters per minute. After how many minutes will the tank contain 140 liters?
A line in the xy-plane passes through the points (−2, 7) and (4, −5). What is the y-intercept of the line?
If 3x − 2y = 6, what is the value of 9x − 6y?
The lines y = ax + 3 and y = 5x − 1 intersect at the point where x = 2. What is the value of a?
explanation_uz: x = 2 da ikkinchi chiziq: y = 9. Birinchisi ham shu nuqtadan o'tadi: 9 = 2a + 3 → a = 3.

stem: For x > 0, which expression is equivalent to x^(3/2)?
A bacteria culture triples in size every 4 hours. If the culture starts with 200 bacteria, how many bacteria will there be after 12 hours?
explanation_uz: 12 soatda 3 marta uch baravar: 200 · 3³ = 200 · 27 = 5 400.
explanation_en: 12 hours is 3 tripling periods: 200 × 27 = 5,400.

stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = x² + 6x + c, where c is a constant. If the minimum value of f is 4, what is the value of c?
explanation_uz: Minimum x = −3 da: 9 − 18 + c = 4 → c = 13.
explanation_en: The minimum is at x = −3: 9 − 18 + c = 4, so c = 13.

stem: For which values of x is the expression (x − 4)/(x² − 16) undefined?
explanation_uz: Maxraj nolga teng bo'lganda aniqlanmagan: x² − 16 = 0 → x = 4 yoki −4. Qisqartirish ham x = 4 ni "tuzatmaydi".
explanation_en: Undefined when the denominator is 0: x² = 16, so x = 4 or −4.

stem: Which of the following is a factor of p(x) = x³ − 4x?
explanation_uz: x³ − 4x = x(x² − 4) = x(x − 2)(x + 2). Ko'paytuvchi: x − 2.
explanation_en: x³ − 4x = x(x − 2)(x + 2), so x − 2 is a factor.

stem: If (2x − 1)/3 = (x + 4)/2, what is the value of x?
explanation_en: Cross-multiply: 4x − 2 = 3x + 12, so x = 14.

stem: At which points does the graph of y = −x² + 6x − 5 intersect the x-axis?
The price of a phone increased by 10% and then decreased by 10%. What is the overall change in the price?
explanation_uz: 1.1 · 0.9 = 0.99 → narx 1% ga kamaygan. Ikkinchi 10% kattaroq summadan hisoblanadi.

stem: The mean of x, 2x, and 3x is 18. What is the value of x?
On a map, 1 centimeter represents 2.5 kilometers. Two towns are 7.2 centimeters apart on the map. What is the actual distance between the towns, in kilometers?
Which of the following data sets has the greatest standard deviation?
explanation_uz: Hammasining o'rtachasi 10. Standart chetlanish — qiymatlar o'rtachadan qanchalik uzoqda. D da qiymatlar eng uzoq (5 va 15).
explanation_en: All have mean 10; D has values farthest from the mean (5 and 15).

stem: A school has 2,000 students. In a random sample of 400 of them, 120 said they bike to school. Based on the sample, about how many students at the school bike to school?
explanation_uz: Namunada ulush: 120 / 400 = 30%. Butun maktab: 2 000 · 0.3 = 600.

stem: A circle has a radius of 9. What is the length of an arc of the circle that has a central angle of 120°?
explanation_uz: Aylana uzunligi 18π. 120° — uning uchdan biri: 18π / 3 = 6π.
explanation_en: Circumference is 18π; 120° is 1/3 of it: 6π.

stem: A rectangle has a diagonal of length 13 and a width of 5. What is the area of the rectangle?
In a right triangle, one angle measures 30° and the hypotenuse has length 14. What is the length of the side opposite the 30° angle?
explanation_uz: 30-60-90 uchburchakda 30° qarshisidagi katet gipotenuzaning yarmi: 14 / 2 = 7.
explanation_en: In a 30-60-90 triangle, the side opposite 30° is half the hypotenuse: 7.

passage: The bakery's bread is so ______ that customers line up before dawn to buy it while it is still warm.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Odamlar tong otmasdan navbatga turishadi — non juda mashhur: "popular".
explanation_en: People line up before dawn, so the bread is "popular."

passage: Although Uzbek and Turkish share many words, their pronunciation and some grammar rules are quite ______, so speakers of one cannot always easily understand the other.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: "Although ... share many words" — zidlik: talaffuz va grammatika farqli: "distinct".
explanation_en: "Although" sets up a contrast with sharing words: they are "distinct."

passage: The negotiator remained ______ throughout the tense meeting, speaking calmly even when others raised their voices.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Boshqalar baqirganda ham xotirjam gapirgan — o'zini tutgan: "composed".
explanation_en: Speaking calmly under pressure means "composed."

passage: Because the original manuscript was lost in a fire, scholars must ______ the poem's first version from three later copies, each of which contains slightly different wording.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Asl qo'lyozma yo'q, uchta nusxadan birinchi variantni qayta tiklash kerak: "reconstruct".
explanation_en: They must rebuild the original from copies: "reconstruct."

passage: Young sunflowers turn to follow the sun across the sky during the day and swing back to face east at night. Once they mature, however, most sunflowers stop moving and face east permanently. Researchers found that east-facing flowers warm up faster in the morning and attract more visiting bees than flowers turned to face west.
stem: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
choices: To describe a behavior of sunflowers and a possible benefit of that behavior
To explain why sunflowers grow best in warm climates
To compare sunflowers with other plants that attract bees
To argue that farmers should plant sunflowers facing west
explanation_uz: Matn kungaboqarning xatti-harakatini (sharqqa qarash) va uning foydasini (ertalab isiydi, ko'proq ari keladi) tasvirlaydi.
explanation_en: It describes a behavior (facing east) and its benefit (warming faster, more bees).

passage: Pianist Timur Aliev recorded the same sonata three times over thirty years. His first recording is fast and brilliant, the second more restrained, and the last so slow that some listeners find it hard to recognize. Critics disagree about which version is best, but most agree that, heard together, the recordings reveal how an artist's understanding of a single work can deepen over a lifetime.
stem: Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
choices: It presents a debate among critics and then resolves it in favor of the first recording.
It explains how pianists prepare to record a sonata.
It describes three versions of a work and then notes what critics see in the differences among them.
It compares the careers of several pianists.
explanation_uz: Avval uchta yozuv tasvirlanadi, keyin tanqidchilar ular orasidagi farqdan nimani ko'rishi aytiladi. Bahs hal qilinmaydi.
explanation_en: Three recordings are described, then what critics see in their differences; no debate is resolved.

passage:
Text 1
Many nutritionists warn that skipping breakfast leads people to overeat later in the day. Hungry by midday, they argue, people who skip breakfast tend to eat larger lunches and more snacks.

Text 2
In a four-week study, adults who skipped breakfast did eat somewhat more at lunch than those who ate breakfast. Over the whole day, however, the breakfast skippers consumed about 250 fewer calories on average.
stem: Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the nutritionists' warning in Text 1?
choices: By agreeing that skipping breakfast leads to eating more calories overall
By noting that although people who skipped breakfast ate more at lunch, they consumed fewer calories over the whole day
By arguing that lunch is more important than breakfast
By claiming that the nutritionists' warning was never tested
explanation_uz: 2-matn bir qismini tasdiqlaydi (tushlikda ko'proq yeyishgan), lekin xulosani rad etadi: kun davomida kamroq kaloriya.
explanation_en: Text 2 confirms bigger lunches but shows fewer total calories, undercutting the "overeating" conclusion.

passage: Tashkent's metro, which opened in 1977, is famous for its decorated stations. Each station has its own theme: one is covered in images of cotton, another honors astronauts, and another is lined with carved marble columns and chandeliers. Many visitors ride the metro simply to see the stations.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
choices: The Tashkent metro is the oldest metro system in Central Asia.
Tashkent's metro stations are known for their elaborate decoration, each with its own artistic theme.
Most visitors to Tashkent prefer the metro to buses.
The metro stations were built using marble from many countries.
explanation_uz: Matnning barcha tafsilotlari stansiyalar bezagi va har birining o'z mavzusi haqida.
explanation_en: Every detail is about the stations' decoration and distinct themes.

passage: Kamola had always thought her grandfather's garden was too small to matter—just a few rows of tomatoes and a single apricot tree. After he fell ill, she began watering it each morning before school. By summer, she noticed neighbors slowing down to admire the apricots and asking for her advice about their own plants. When her grandfather finally came home, she showed him the garden with a pride she had not expected to feel.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
choices: Kamola's grandfather taught her everything he knew about gardening.
Kamola wanted to sell the apricots to her neighbors.
Kamola's neighbors had larger gardens than her grandfather.
Caring for the garden changes Kamola's view of its value.
explanation_uz: Avval: bog' ahamiyatsiz. Keyin: g'urur bilan ko'rsatadi. Asosiy g'oya — g'amxo'rlik uning qarashini o'zgartirgan.
explanation_en: She starts out dismissing the garden and ends proud of it: her view changes.

passage: In a play, the character Bekzod is portrayed as impatient.
stem: Which quotation from the play most effectively illustrates this portrayal of Bekzod?
choices: "Must we wait for the entire council?" Bekzod demanded, already reaching for his coat.
Bekzod listened quietly as the elders discussed the harvest.
"I have known your family for many years," Bekzod said warmly.
Bekzod wrote a long letter to his brother explaining his plans.
explanation_uz: Sabrsizlik: "Butun kengashni kutamizmi?" deb talab qiladi va allaqachon paltosiga qo'l cho'zadi.
explanation_en: Demanding not to wait and already reaching for his coat shows impatience.

passage: A biologist claims that crows can recognize individual human faces and remember people who have threatened them.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the biologist's claim?
choices: Crows in cities gathered in larger flocks than crows in the countryside.
Crows were more likely to visit feeders that were placed near trees.
Crows that had been captured by researchers wearing a particular mask scolded people wearing that same mask years later but ignored people wearing other masks.
Crows learned to drop nuts on roads so that cars would crack them.
explanation_uz: Da'vo: yuzni taniydi va tahdidni eslaydi. C: aynan shu niqobdagi odamlarga yillar o'tib ham qichqiradi, boshqalarga yo'q.
explanation_en: C shows crows singling out one specific "face" years later, which supports the claim.

passage:
Average commute time for students at one university, by travel method

Car — 34 minutes
Bus — 41 minutes
Bicycle — 22 minutes
Walking — 18 minutes

A student newspaper reports that students who bike or walk to campus have shorter commutes, on average, than students who drive or take the bus.
stem: Which choice best uses data from the table to support the newspaper's report?
choices: Students who take the bus have the longest average commute.
Students who drive have an average commute of 34 minutes.
Walking is the most common way students get to campus.
Biking (22 minutes) and walking (18 minutes) both took less time, on average, than driving (34 minutes) or taking the bus (41 minutes).
explanation_uz: Da'vo to'rt usulni ikki guruhga ajratib solishtiradi. Faqat D to'rttasini ham keltiradi. C jadvalda yo'q.
explanation_en: Only D compares all four methods as the claim requires; C isn't in the table.

passage:
Apple varieties: sugar content and storage life

Variety K — 14% sugar — stores 3 months
Variety L — 11% sugar — stores 6 months
Variety M — 16% sugar — stores 2 months

A fruit grower comparing three apple varieties notes that the data suggest a trade-off: ______
stem: Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
choices: varieties with higher sugar content could be stored for less time; Variety M (16%) lasted 2 months, while Variety L (11%) lasted 6 months.
all three varieties could be stored for at least 2 months.
Variety L is the most popular apple among customers.
explanation_uz: "Trade-off" — biri oshsa, ikkinchisi kamayadi. A buni ko'rsatadi: shakar ko'p → saqlash muddati qisqa.
explanation_en: A trade-off means one rises as the other falls: more sugar, shorter storage.

passage: In a mountain lake, the population of a small fish that feeds on algae fell sharply after anglers introduced a larger predatory fish. During the same period, the amount of algae in the lake increased noticeably. Based on these observations, researchers predict that if the predatory fish were removed, ______
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
choices: the algae would disappear entirely within a year.
the small fish population would likely recover, and the amount of algae would likely decrease.
the small fish would begin eating the predatory fish.
the amount of algae would continue to increase.
explanation_uz: Yirtqich → mayda baliq kamaydi → suvo'ti ko'paydi. Yirtqich olib tashlansa, zanjir teskari ishlaydi.
explanation_en: Remove the predator and the chain reverses: small fish recover and eat more algae.

passage: The library extended its hours during exam ______ students could study there until midnight.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ikki mustaqil gapni "so" bog'laganda undan OLDIN vergul qo'yiladi, keyin emas.
explanation_en: When "so" joins two independent clauses, the comma goes before it.

passage: On a clear night, visitors to the observatory can see three ______ Jupiter, Saturn, and Mars.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ikki nuqta ro'yxatni kiritadi: qaysi uchta sayyora.
explanation_en: A colon introduces the list naming the three planets.

passage: The violin, which was made in ______ is still played in concerts today.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: "which was made in 1720" izohi vergul bilan boshlangan, vergul bilan yopilishi kerak.
explanation_en: The clause began with a comma, so it must end with one.

passage: The team didn't just win the ______ it also set a record for the most goals scored in a single season.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ikki mustaqil gap — nuqtali vergul bilan ajratiladi. Faqat vergul — comma splice.
explanation_en: Two independent clauses: a semicolon works; a comma alone is a comma splice.

passage: Last month, the students in Ms. Karimova's art class ______ a large mural for the school entrance.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: "Last month" — o'tgan zamon: painted.
explanation_en: "Last month" calls for the past tense: "painted."

passage: Each of the twelve volunteers ______ given a map, a flashlight, and a bottle of water before the search began.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ega — "Each" (birlik). O'tgan zamon, birlik: was.
explanation_en: "Each" is singular and the context is past: "was."

passage: The lead scientist, along with her two assistants, ______ expected to present the results at tomorrow's meeting.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: "along with her two assistants" egani o'zgartirmaydi. Ega — "The lead scientist" (birlik): is.
explanation_en: "Along with ..." doesn't change the subject, "scientist" (singular): "is."

passage: Koalas spend most of the day asleep. ______ they may sleep for as many as 20 hours in a single day.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Ikkinchi gap birinchisini kuchaytiradi va aniq raqam beradi: "In fact".
explanation_en: The second sentence intensifies the first with a specific number: "In fact."

passage: Paper maps were once essential for anyone taking a long road trip. ______ most travelers rely on navigation apps on their phones.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: O'tmish (qog'oz xaritalar) va hozir (ilovalar) qarama-qarshi qo'yilgan: "Today, however".
explanation_en: Past vs. present contrast: "Today, however."

passage: The scholarship committee reviewed more than 300 applications this year. Of these, only 12 met every requirement. ______ the committee decided to extend the deadline and invite more students to apply.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Talabga javob beradiganlar juda kam → shunga ko'ra muddat uzaytirildi. "Accordingly" — shunga muvofiq.
explanation_en: So few qualified that the committee extended the deadline: "Accordingly."

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Hummingbirds are among the smallest birds in the world.
• Most species weigh between 2 and 20 grams.
• Their hearts can beat more than 1,000 times per minute.
• Unlike most birds, hummingbirds can fly backward.
stem: The student wants to emphasize an unusual flying ability of hummingbirds. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Hummingbirds are among the smallest birds in the world.
A hummingbird's heart can beat more than 1,000 times per minute.
Most hummingbird species weigh between 2 and 20 grams.
Unlike most birds, hummingbirds are able to fly backward.
explanation_uz: Maqsad — g'ayrioddiy UCHISH qobiliyati. Faqat D uchish haqida: orqaga ucha oladi.
explanation_en: Only D is about flying: they can fly backward.

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Saida Ergasheva is an Uzbek novelist.
• Her novel The Long Shore is set in a fishing town in the 1950s.
• Her novel Glass City is set in a futuristic city.
• Both novels focus on relationships between parents and children.
stem: The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two novels. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: The Long Shore is set in the 1950s, while Glass City is set in the future.
Saida Ergasheva's novel Glass City is set in a futuristic city.
Although they are set in very different places and times, both The Long Shore and Glass City focus on relationships between parents and children.
Saida Ergasheva is an Uzbek novelist who has written at least two books.
explanation_uz: Maqsad — o'xshashlik. C ikkala roman ham ota-ona va farzand munosabatlari haqida ekanini ta'kidlaydi.
explanation_en: C highlights what both novels share: parent-child relationships.

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Biomimicry is the practice of designing products based on structures found in nature.
• Velcro was inspired by burrs that stuck to a dog's fur.
• The nose of a Japanese high-speed train was shaped like a kingfisher's beak.
• The train's new shape made it quieter and more efficient.
stem: The student wants to explain the term biomimicry to a general audience, using an example. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: The nose of a Japanese high-speed train was redesigned to make it quieter.
Biomimicry—designing products based on structures found in nature—has led to inventions such as Velcro, which was inspired by burrs that stuck to a dog's fur.
Velcro and high-speed trains are both examples of modern technology.
A kingfisher's beak is long and pointed.
explanation_uz: Maqsad — atamani tushuntirish + misol. B ta'rifni ham, misolni (Velcro) ham beradi.
explanation_en: B both defines the term and gives an example (Velcro).

passage: The witness's account was ______: it changed in small but significant ways each time she told it.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Har safar aytganda o'zgargan — izchil emas: "inconsistent".
explanation_en: It changed with each telling: "inconsistent."

passage: The historian's reputation rests less on any single groundbreaking discovery than on the ______ accumulation of careful studies over four decades.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: "Less on a single discovery" ga qarama-qarshi — qirq yil davomida asta-sekin to'plangan: "steady".
explanation_en: Contrasted with one discovery, four decades of studies suggest a "steady" accumulation.

passage: Far from being a ______ figure, the poet was deeply involved in the political debates of her time, writing essays and organizing public readings.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: "Far from being ..." — aksincha. U jamiyat hayotida faol edi, demak u odamovi ("reclusive") emas edi.
explanation_en: "Far from" signals the opposite of being very involved: "reclusive."

passage: The manager's decision to ______ the new scheduling policy, rather than enforce it all at once, gave employees several months to adjust.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Bir vaqtda emas, oylar davomida asta-sekin joriy qilish: "phase in".
explanation_en: Introducing it gradually over months is to "phase in."

passage: My father measured distances not in kilometers but in songs. The drive to my aunt's village was "eleven songs long," and the trip to the bazaar was "two songs, if the traffic is kind." Years later, when I made the same drives alone, I caught myself counting songs on the radio instead of watching the road signs.
stem: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
choices: To explain why the narrator's family preferred music to conversation
To illustrate a distinctive way the narrator's father thought about travel and its lasting effect on the narrator
To describe the roads between the narrator's home and her aunt's village
To argue that road signs are less useful than music
explanation_uz: Otasi masofani qo'shiqlar bilan o'lchagan va bu odat narratorda ham qolgan. B ikkalasini qamrab oladi.
explanation_en: B covers both the father's unusual habit and how it stayed with the narrator.

passage: Some critics dismiss video games as a waste of time. Yet researchers have found that certain strategy games can improve players' ability to plan ahead and to switch quickly between tasks. These findings do not show that all games are beneficial, but they suggest that the question deserves closer study than critics have given it.
stem: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
choices: To prove that all video games improve players' thinking
To describe the history of strategy games
To explain how researchers design video games
To argue that the effects of video games are more complex than some critics suggest
explanation_uz: Tanqidchilar: vaqtni behuda sarflash. Matn: ba'zi o'yinlar foydali, lekin hammasi emas — masala murakkabroq.
explanation_en: The text pushes back on critics without claiming all games help: the issue is more complex.

passage:
Text 1
Some astronomers propose that an undiscovered planet, several times the mass of Earth, orbits far beyond Neptune. As evidence, they point out that the orbits of several small, distant objects appear to be clustered in the same direction, a pattern they argue could be caused by the gravity of such a planet.

Text 2
Other researchers caution that the apparent clustering may not be real. Surveys of the distant solar system can only observe certain parts of the sky at certain times of year, so the objects that have been discovered so far may not represent the full population.
stem: Based on the texts, how would the researchers in Text 2 most likely respond to the evidence presented in Text 1?
choices: By suggesting that the pattern used as evidence for the planet may result from where and when astronomers have been able to look
By agreeing that the planet's gravity explains the clustering
By arguing that the distant objects are larger than previously thought
By claiming that Neptune is responsible for the clustering
explanation_uz: 1-matn dalili — orbitalarning to'planishi. 2-matn: bu kuzatuv cheklovlari (osmonning faqat ba'zi qismlari) natijasi bo'lishi mumkin.
explanation_en: Text 2 says the clustering might be an artifact of which parts of the sky surveys could observe.

passage: The Uzbek language contains many words borrowed from other languages. Words such as kitob ("book") and maktab ("school") come from Arabic, while daraxt ("tree") and do'st ("friend") come from Persian. More recent borrowings, such as poyezd ("train"), come from Russian. Linguists note that these layers of vocabulary reflect centuries of trade, scholarship, and political contact.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
choices: Arabic has had a greater influence on Uzbek than any other language.
Most Uzbek words for modern technology come from English.
Words borrowed into Uzbek from several languages reflect the region's long history of contact with other cultures.
Linguists disagree about where the word kitob comes from.
explanation_uz: Misollar (arabcha, forscha, ruscha) bitta g'oyani ko'rsatadi: qatlamlar tarixiy aloqalarni aks ettiradi.
explanation_en: The examples from three languages support one idea: borrowings reflect a history of contact.

passage: Engineers inspecting a 100-year-old stone bridge expected to find that its mortar had crumbled. Instead, tests showed that the mortar was harder than when it had been laid. Its builders had mixed lime with crushed brick, and over the decades the mixture had slowly reacted with water and air, filling tiny cracks and binding the stones more tightly.
stem: According to the text, what did the engineers discover about the bridge?
choices: It needed to be replaced with modern concrete.
Its mortar had become stronger over time rather than weaker.
It had been built with stones carried from distant quarries.
Its builders had used no mortar at all.
explanation_uz: Matnda: kutilgan narsa (eritma yemirilgan) o'rniga eritma qattiqroq bo'lib chiqqan.
explanation_en: Tests showed the mortar was harder than when laid: it strengthened over time.

passage: In an essay, writer Zarina Abdullaeva suggests that boredom can be useful.
stem: Which quotation from the essay most effectively illustrates Abdullaeva's suggestion?
choices: "My schedule as a student was always full, from early morning until late at night."
"Boredom is something most people try to avoid at all costs."
"I have never enjoyed waiting in long lines."
"Some of my best ideas arrived on long, empty afternoons when there was nothing at all to do."
explanation_uz: Da'vo: zerikish FOYDALI. D: eng yaxshi g'oyalar bo'sh, zerikarli kunlarda kelgan.
explanation_en: D links boredom (empty afternoons) to a benefit (best ideas).

passage: Some scientists hypothesize that yawning helps to cool the brain.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support this hypothesis?
choices: People yawned more often when they were tired than when they were well rested.
Yawning was more common in the evening than in the morning.
Participants who held a cold pack to their foreheads yawned less often than participants who held a warm pack.
People often yawned after seeing someone else yawn.
explanation_uz: Agar esnash miyani sovutsa, miya allaqachon sovutilganda (sovuq kompress) esnash kamroq bo'lishi kerak. C aynan shuni ko'rsatadi.
explanation_en: If yawning cools the brain, cooling the head another way should reduce yawning, which is what C shows.

passage:
Enrollment in language courses at a university

Korean — 2019: 140 — 2024: 410
Spanish — 2019: 520 — 2024: 540
Chinese — 2019: 300 — 2024: 280
Japanese — 2019: 210 — 2024: 330

A university administrator claims that Korean had the largest growth in enrollment between 2019 and 2024.
stem: Which choice best uses data from the table to support the administrator's claim?
choices: Enrollment in Korean rose by 270 students, from 140 to 410, a larger increase than for any other language in the table.
Spanish had the highest enrollment in both 2019 and 2024.
Enrollment in Chinese fell from 300 to 280.
explanation_uz: "Eng katta o'sish" — o'sishni boshqalar bilan solishtirish kerak: Koreys +270, Yapon +120, Ispan +20, Xitoy −20.
explanation_en: "Largest growth" needs a comparison of increases: Korean +270 beats all others.

passage:
Germination rate of two seed types

Type A — at 10°C: 35% — at 25°C: 80%
Type B — at 10°C: 70% — at 25°C: 45%

A botanist tested how temperature affects the germination of two types of wildflower seeds. Type A seeds germinated much better at the warmer temperature, but ______
stem: Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
choices: Type A seeds germinated at a rate of 80% at 25°C.
Type B seeds showed the opposite pattern, germinating at a rate of 70% at 10°C but only 45% at 25°C.
both types of seeds germinated at some rate at both temperatures.
Type B seeds germinated at a lower rate than Type A seeds at 25°C.
explanation_uz: "but" — A ga qarama-qarshi naqsh kerak: B sovuqda yaxshiroq unadi (70%), issiqda yomonroq (45%).
explanation_en: "But" needs the contrasting pattern: B does better in the cold (70%) than the warmth (45%).

passage: A medieval manuscript from the city of Herat uses a bright blue ink made from a mineral that was mined in only one distant region. City account books show that merchants first began bringing this mineral to Herat after 1350, and no earlier records mention it. It is therefore likely that ______
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
choices: the mineral was never used in Herat.
merchants in Herat preferred red ink to blue ink.
the manuscript, or at least the parts written in that ink, was produced no earlier than 1350.
explanation_uz: Mineral Hiratga faqat 1350 dan keyin kelgan → u bilan yozilgan qismlar 1350 dan oldin yozilgan bo'lishi mumkin emas.
explanation_en: The ink's mineral reached Herat only after 1350, so the ink work can't predate 1350.

passage: The chef's signature dish combines three unlikely ______ dried apricots, black pepper, and fresh mint.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ikki nuqta "three ingredients" ro'yxatini kiritadi.
explanation_en: A colon introduces the list of three ingredients.

passage: Researchers tracked the ______ movements across the steppe using small GPS collars.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ko'plik: wolf → wolves. Ko'plik egalik: wolves'.
explanation_en: Plural of wolf is "wolves"; plural possessive is "wolves'."

passage: Long before the invention of the mechanical ______ people kept time with sundials, water clocks, and candles marked with evenly spaced lines.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Kirish qismi ("Long before ... clock") asosiy gapdan vergul bilan ajratiladi.
explanation_en: An introductory phrase is separated from the main clause by a comma.

passage: The expedition's ______ a geologist who had spent twenty years studying glaciers—was the first to notice the crack in the ice.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Izoh tire bilan yopilgan ("glaciers—"), demak tire bilan boshlanishi ham kerak.
explanation_en: The interruption ends with a dash, so it must begin with one.

passage: The number of students who apply to the summer program ______ increased every year since 2018.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: "The number of ..." — birlik ega. "since 2018" — Present Perfect: has increased.
explanation_en: "The number" is singular, and "since 2018" needs present perfect: "has."

passage: Walking through the old bazaar in Samarkand, ______
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
choices: spices that Jasur had never seen before caught his attention.
the smell of cumin and saffron filled the air.
there were many spices that Jasur had never seen.
Jasur noticed spices that he had never seen before.
explanation_uz: Bozor bo'ylab kim yurgan? Jasur. Vergul ortidan darhol "Jasur" kelishi kerak.
explanation_en: Jasur is the one walking, so he must follow the comma.

passage: Unlike most of ______ classmates, the young composer chose to write music for traditional instruments such as the doira and the dutar.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Olmosh "the young composer" (bitta shaxs) ga ishora qiladi — "her". "Their" ko'plik.
explanation_en: The pronoun refers to one person, the composer: "her."

passage: Many people assume that deserts are always hot. ______ temperatures in the Gobi Desert can fall below −40°C in winter.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Keng tarqalgan fikr (doim issiq) va unga zid fakt (−40°C): "Yet".
explanation_en: The fact contradicts the assumption: "Yet."

passage: The first draft of the novel was more than 900 pages long. ______ the author cut nearly a third of it before publication.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Birinchi qoralama → oxir-oqibat nashrdan oldin qisqartirildi. Yakuniy natija: "Ultimately".
explanation_en: The draft was eventually cut down: the final outcome, "Ultimately."

passage: Some birds migrate thousands of kilometers each year. Others, ______ remain in the same small area their entire lives.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Ko'chib yuruvchi qushlar va bir joyda qoladiganlar qarama-qarshi: "however".
explanation_en: Migrating vs. staying put is a contrast: "however."

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Muhammad ibn Musa al-Khwarizmi was a ninth-century mathematician.
• He came from the region of Khwarazm in Central Asia.
• His book on solving equations was studied by scholars for centuries.
• The word "algorithm" comes from a Latin version of his name.
stem: The student wants to explain the origin of a common word. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Al-Khwarizmi was a ninth-century mathematician from Central Asia.
Al-Khwarizmi's book on solving equations was studied by scholars for centuries.
Al-Khwarizmi came from the region of Khwarazm.
The word "algorithm" comes from a Latin version of the name of al-Khwarizmi, a ninth-century mathematician from Central Asia.
explanation_uz: Maqsad — so'zning kelib chiqishi. Faqat D "algorithm" so'zi al-Xorazmiy ismidan kelganini tushuntiradi.
explanation_en: Only D explains where the word "algorithm" comes from.

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Restoration of the old observatory's dome began in 2012.
• About 40 workers took part in the project.
• The project cost about $3 million.
• The restoration was completed in 2019, when the observatory reopened to the public.
stem: The student wants to emphasize how long the restoration project took. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: The restoration of the observatory's dome took seven years, from 2012 to 2019.
About 40 workers helped restore the observatory's dome.
Restoring the observatory's dome cost about $3 million.
The observatory reopened to the public after its dome was restored.
explanation_uz: Maqsad — davomiylik. A: yetti yil, 2012–2019.
explanation_en: The goal is duration: A gives seven years, 2012–2019.

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Researchers wondered whether bees can learn to count.
• They trained bees to fly past a certain number of landmarks to reach food.
• Then they changed the distance between the landmarks.
• The bees still stopped after the correct number of landmarks.
stem: The student wants to present the research question the study addressed. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Bees stopped after the correct number of landmarks even when the distance between them changed.
Researchers trained bees to fly past landmarks to reach food.
Researchers set out to determine whether bees can learn to count.
The study shows that bees can find food more easily than other insects.
explanation_uz: Tadqiqot savoli — nimani bilmoqchi bo'lishgan: arilar sanashni o'rgana oladimi.
explanation_en: The research question is what they wanted to find out: whether bees can count.

stem: If 3x + 8 = 29, what is the value of x?
Which equation represents the statement "five more than twice a number n is 17"?
explanation_uz: "Twice a number" = 2n, "five more than" = + 5: 2n + 5 = 17.
explanation_en: Twice n is 2n; five more is 2n + 5 = 17.

stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = 6 − x. What is the value of f(−4)?
A taxi charges $3 plus $1.20 for each kilometer traveled. A ride cost $15. How many kilometers was the ride?
Which of the following describes all solutions to −2x + 5 ≤ 1?
explanation_uz: −2x ≤ −4. Manfiy songa bo'lganda belgi o'zgaradi: x ≥ 2.
explanation_en: −2x ≤ −4; dividing by −2 flips the sign: x ≥ 2.

stem: A line in the xy-plane has a slope of 2 and passes through the point (3, 10). What is the y-coordinate of the line's y-intercept?

x = 3y + 1
2x − 5y = 4

What is the value of y in the solution to the system above?
explanation_uz: x ni qo'yamiz: 2(3y + 1) − 5y = 4 → y + 2 = 4 → y = 2.
explanation_en: Substitute: 6y + 2 − 5y = 4, so y = 2.

stem: A store sells pens for $2 each and markers for $5 each. Leila bought 13 items and spent $41. How many markers did she buy?
Which expression is equivalent to 2(x² − 3x) − x²?
explanation_uz: 2x² − 6x − x² = x² − 6x.
explanation_en: 2x² − 6x − x² = x² − 6x.

stem: What are the solutions to x² − 9x + 20 = 0?
The function g is defined by g(x) = 2x² − 3. What is the value of g(4)?
An investment of $1,000 earns 4% interest compounded once per year. What is the value of the investment after 2 years?
explanation_en: 1,000 × 1.04² = $1,081.60 ($1,080 would be simple interest).

stem: The functions f and g are defined by f(x) = x² and g(x) = x + 3. What is the value of f(g(2))?
explanation_uz: Avval g(2) = 5, keyin f(5) = 25.

stem: If x² + 8x + k = (x + 4)² for all values of x, what is the value of k?
explanation_uz: (x + 4)² = x² + 8x + 16, demak k = 16.

stem: Which equation has solutions x = −3 and x = 5?
15 is what percent of 60?
A car uses 6 liters of fuel for every 100 kilometers driven. How many liters of fuel will the car use to drive 350 kilometers?
What is the range of the data set 14, 9, 22, 17, 11?
explanation_uz: Diapazon = eng katta − eng kichik = 22 − 9 = 13.

stem: In a group of 120 students, 70 play a sport. Of the students who play a sport, 40 are in grade 10. Of the students who do not play a sport, 30 are in grade 10. If a grade 10 student from this group is chosen at random, what is the probability that the student plays a sport?
explanation_uz: 10-sinflar jami: 40 + 30 = 70. Ulardan sport bilan shug'ullanadiganlar 40: 40/70 = 4/7.
explanation_en: Grade 10 total = 40 + 30 = 70; of those, 40 play a sport: 4/7.

stem: A square has a perimeter of 36 centimeters. What is the area of the square, in square centimeters?
explanation_uz: Tomoni 36 / 4 = 9, yuzasi 9² = 81.
explanation_en: Side = 9, area = 81.

stem: Two vertical angles have measures (3x + 10)° and (5x − 30)°. What is the value of x?
explanation_uz: Vertikal burchaklar teng: 3x + 10 = 5x − 30 → 2x = 40 → x = 20.
explanation_en: Vertical angles are equal: 3x + 10 = 5x − 30, so x = 20.

stem: In the xy-plane, point A has coordinates (1, 2) and point B has coordinates (7, 10). What is the distance between A and B?
If 4(x − 2) = 2(x + 5), what is the value of x?
What is the slope of the line defined by 3x − 4y = 12 in the xy-plane?
explanation_uz: y ga keltiramiz: −4y = −3x + 12 → y = (3/4)x − 3. Qiyalik 3/4.
explanation_en: Solve for y: y = (3/4)x − 3; slope 3/4.

stem: The lines 2x + y = 7 and x − y = −1 intersect at the point (a, b). What is the value of a + b?
explanation_uz: Qo'shamiz: 3x = 6 → x = 2, y = 3. a + b = 5.

stem:
5(x + c) = 5x + 15

In the equation above, c is a constant. For what value of c does the equation have infinitely many solutions?
explanation_uz: 5x + 5c = 5x + 15 → 5c = 15 → c = 3. Shunda tenglama har qanday x uchun to'g'ri.
explanation_en: 5c = 15, so c = 3; then the equation is true for all x.

stem: Account A has $500 and grows by $40 each month. Account B has $820 and decreases by $40 each month. After how many months will the two accounts have the same balance?
The graph of the linear function f passes through the point (2, −1) and has a slope of −3. What is the value of f(0)?

A delivery van can carry at most 900 kilograms. The driver weighs 75 kilograms, and each box weighs 25 kilograms. Which inequality represents the number of boxes, b, that the van can carry along with the driver?
explanation_uz: Haydovchi 75 + qutilar 25b, "at most 900" → ≤ 900.
explanation_en: Driver 75 plus 25b for boxes, at most 900: 75 + 25b ≤ 900.

stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = (x − 1)(x − 5). What is the minimum value of f(x)?
explanation_uz: Uch ildizlar o'rtasida: x = 3. f(3) = (2)(−2) = −4. (3 — bu x, qiymat emas.)
explanation_en: The vertex is at x = 3; f(3) = (2)(−2) = −4.

stem: If 2^(3x) = 64, what is the value of x?
explanation_en: 64 = 2⁶, so 3x = 6 and x = 2.

stem: Which expression is equivalent to (x + 2)(x² − 2x + 4)?
explanation_uz: Ochamiz: x³ − 2x² + 4x + 2x² − 4x + 8 = x³ + 8.
explanation_en: Expanding, the middle terms cancel: x³ + 8.

stem: The value, in dollars, of a machine t years after purchase is modeled by V(t) = 1,500(0.9)^t. Which statement best describes the meaning of 0.9 in this model?
choices: The value increases by 90% each year.
The value decreases by 90% each year.
The value decreases by 10% each year.
The value decreases by $0.90 each year.
explanation_uz: Har yili qiymatning 90% i qoladi, ya'ni 10% ga kamayadi.
explanation_en: Keeping 90% each year means a 10% decrease each year.

stem: If x − 1/x = 3, what is the value of x² + 1/x²?
explanation_uz: Kvadratga ko'taramiz: x² − 2 + 1/x² = 9 → x² + 1/x² = 11.
explanation_en: Square both sides: x² − 2 + 1/x² = 9, so x² + 1/x² = 11.

stem: What is the solution to the equation √(x + 7) = x − 5?
explanation_uz: Kvadratga: x + 7 = x² − 10x + 25 → x² − 11x + 18 = 0 → x = 2 yoki 9. Tekshiruv: x = 2 da √9 = 3, lekin 2 − 5 = −3 — mos emas. Faqat x = 9.
explanation_en: Squaring gives x = 2 or 9, but x = 2 fails (√9 ≠ −3). Only x = 9 works.

stem: The length of a rectangle is 3 centimeters more than its width. The area of the rectangle is 70 square centimeters. What is the width of the rectangle, in centimeters?
After a 25% discount, a bicycle costs $180. What was the original price of the bicycle?
explanation_uz: Chegirmadan keyin narxning 75% i qolgan: 0.75p = 180 → p = 240. ($225 — 180 ga 25% qo'shish, xato.)

stem: The average score of 30 students on a test was 72. A new student took the test and scored 103. What is the average score of all 31 students?
A recipe for 4 servings uses 300 grams of pasta. How many grams of pasta are needed for 10 servings?
explanation_uz: Bir porsiya: 300 / 4 = 75 g. O'nta: 750 g.
explanation_en: 75 g per serving × 10 = 750 g.

stem: The height h, in centimeters, of a plant w weeks after it was planted is modeled by h = 2.5w + 12. What is the best interpretation of 12 in this context?
choices: The plant grows 12 centimeters each week.
The estimated height of the plant, in centimeters, when it was planted
The number of weeks it takes the plant to grow 2.5 centimeters
The estimated height of the plant after 12 weeks
explanation_uz: w = 0 da h = 12 — o'tqazilgan paytdagi bo'yi. 2.5 — haftalik o'sish.
explanation_en: When w = 0, h = 12: the height at planting. 2.5 is the weekly growth.

stem: A poll estimates that 54% of voters support a proposal, with a margin of error of 3 percentage points. Which of the following is a plausible value for the actual percentage of voters who support the proposal?
explanation_uz: Ehtimoliy oraliq: 54 ± 3 → 51% dan 57% gacha. Faqat 52% shu oraliqda.
explanation_en: The plausible range is 51% to 57%; only 52% falls in it.

stem: A circle in the xy-plane has its center at the origin and passes through the point (6, 8). Which equation defines the circle?
explanation_uz: Radius = √(6² + 8²) = 10. Tenglama: x² + y² = r² = 100.

stem: An isosceles right triangle has a hypotenuse of length 10√2. What is the area of the triangle?
explanation_uz: Teng yonli to'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda gipotenuza = katet · √2, demak katetlar 10. Yuza: 10 · 10 / 2 = 50.
explanation_en: Legs are 10 (hypotenuse = leg × √2); area = (10 × 10)/2 = 50.

stem: A right circular cone has a radius of 3 and a height of 4. What is the volume of the cone?
explanation_uz: V = (1/3)πr²h = (1/3) · π · 9 · 4 = 12π. (36π — silindr hajmi.)
explanation_en: V = (1/3)π(9)(4) = 12π. (36π is the cylinder's volume.)

passage: The museum guide was so ______ that even visitors who had never cared about pottery stayed to ask her questions for an hour.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Hatto qiziqmaganlar ham bir soat savol berishgan — gid qiziqarli edi: "engaging".
explanation_en: Uninterested visitors stayed an hour, so she was "engaging."

passage: The new policy is meant to ______ paperwork for small businesses, cutting the number of required forms from twelve to three.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Hujjatlar 12 tadan 3 taga qisqargan — soddalashtirish: "simplify".
explanation_en: Cutting forms from 12 to 3 is to "simplify."

passage: The scientists were ______ by the results: the experiment produced the exact opposite of what every model had predicted.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Natija barcha bashoratlarga zid — olimlar hayron qolgan: "baffled".
explanation_en: Results contradicting every model left them "baffled."

passage: Although the author's style is often described as plain, her choice of words is anything but ______: each sentence is carefully built to create a precise effect.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: "Anything but X" — mutlaqo X emas. Har bir gap puxta qurilgan, demak u beparvo emas: "careless".
explanation_en: "Anything but" means not at all; carefully built sentences are not "careless."

passage: Long before refrigerators, people in the deserts of Iran stored ice through the hot summer in structures called yakhchals. In winter, water was channeled into shallow pools, where it froze overnight. The ice was then cut into blocks and stored in a deep pit beneath a tall dome whose thick walls, made of a special mortar, kept heat out.
stem: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
choices: To compare yakhchals with modern refrigerators
To explain how a traditional structure kept ice frozen in a hot climate
To argue that yakhchals should be rebuilt today
To describe the climate of the deserts of Iran
explanation_uz: Matn yaxchal QANDAY ishlaganini bosqichma-bosqich tushuntiradi: muzlatish, kesish, qalin devorli gumbaz ostida saqlash.
explanation_en: It explains step by step how yakhchals kept ice frozen through summer.

passage: Linguists studying a mountain village's dialect recorded older residents in 1990 and younger residents in 2020. The older speakers used three different words to describe kinds of snow, while most younger speakers used only one. The researchers suggest that the change occurred because far fewer young people now herd animals or work outdoors in winter.
stem: Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
choices: It presents a theory and then lists evidence against it.
It compares the dialects of two different villages.
It explains how linguists record speech.
It describes a change in language use and then offers an explanation for it.
explanation_uz: Avval o'zgarish (3 so'z → 1 so'z), keyin sababi (qishda tashqarida kam ishlashadi).
explanation_en: It describes a change (three words to one) and then a likely cause.

passage:
Text 1
City planners often propose widening busy roads to reduce traffic jams. Adding lanes, they argue, gives cars more room and allows traffic to flow more smoothly.

Text 2
Studies of many cities have found a pattern known as induced demand: when a road is widened, driving becomes more convenient, so more people choose to drive. Within a few years, the new lanes are often as crowded as the old ones were.
stem: Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the city planners in Text 1?
choices: By arguing that the benefits of widening roads are likely to be temporary
By agreeing that adding lanes permanently solves traffic problems
By claiming that wider roads are more dangerous for drivers
By suggesting that cities should build more parking lots
explanation_uz: 2-matn: yo'l kengaysa, ko'proq odam mashina haydaydi va bir necha yilda yana tirbandlik. Ya'ni foyda vaqtinchalik.
explanation_en: Induced demand means new lanes fill up within a few years: the benefit is temporary.

passage: Mangrove trees grow along tropical coastlines, where their tangled roots rise above the water. These roots slow incoming waves and trap mud, which reduces erosion and protects coastal villages during storms. The calm water among the roots also provides a safe place for young fish to grow.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
choices: Mangrove roots grow faster than the roots of other trees.
Coastal villages are often damaged by storms.
Mangrove forests help protect coastlines and support marine life.
Young fish cannot survive in the open ocean.
explanation_uz: Ikki asosiy foyda: qirg'oqni himoya qiladi va baliqlarga boshpana beradi. C ikkalasini qamraydi.
explanation_en: The text gives two benefits: protecting coasts and sheltering young fish. C covers both.

passage: Davron had never been good at saying goodbye. At the airport, while his sister talked excitedly about her new job abroad, he checked the departure board again and again, asked twice whether she had her passport, and offered to buy her a third bottle of water. Only when she hugged him at the security gate did he realize he had not said anything that really mattered.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
choices: Davron expresses his feelings about his sister's departure indirectly, through small practical concerns.
Davron is angry that his sister is moving abroad.
Davron's sister forgot her passport at home.
Davron prefers traveling by train to traveling by plane.
explanation_uz: Davron his-tuyg'ularini aytmaydi, o'rniga mayda amaliy ishlar bilan band bo'ladi (pasport, suv) — xayrlashish qiyin.
explanation_en: Instead of saying what he feels, Davron fusses over practical details.
