passage: In the novel River of Stars, the narrator often expresses nostalgia for her childhood home.
stem: Which quotation from River of Stars most effectively illustrates the narrator's nostalgia?
choices: "The city where I now live is crowded and loud."
"Even now, the smell of rain on dust carries me back to the courtyard where I spent every summer as a girl."
"My brother became an engineer and moved to the capital."
"I have always preferred mornings to evenings."
explanation_uz: Nostalgiya — o'tmishni sog'inish. B: yomg'ir hidi uni bolalikdagi hovlisiga qaytaradi.
explanation_en: B shows a present sensation pulling her back to her childhood courtyard.

passage: A plant biologist hypothesizes that plants of a certain species growing at the edge of a forest have thicker leaves than those in the forest interior because the edge plants receive more light.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the biologist's hypothesis?
choices: Plants at the forest edge were taller than plants in the interior.
The forest interior received more rainfall than the forest edge.
Insects ate more leaves at the forest edge than in the interior.
Plants moved from the interior to the edge developed thicker leaves within one season, while plants moved from the edge to the interior developed thinner leaves.
explanation_uz: Gipoteza: yorug'lik → qalin barg. D da o'simlik ko'chirilganda barg qalinligi yorug'likka qarab o'zgargan — sababni bevosita ko'rsatadi.
explanation_en: Leaf thickness changed in both directions when light changed: direct support for light as the cause.

passage:
Average hours of sunshine per day in a city

January — 4 hours
April — 8 hours
July — 12 hours
October — 7 hours

A travel writer claims that July has the most sunshine of the months shown, with about three times as much as January.
stem: Which choice best uses data from the table to support the writer's claim?
choices: April averaged twice as much sunshine as January.
October averaged 7 hours of sunshine per day.
July averaged 12 hours of sunshine per day, three times January's average of 4 hours.
Every month shown averaged at least 4 hours of sunshine per day.
explanation_uz: Da'vo iyulni yanvar bilan solishtiradi: 12 = 3 · 4. C aynan shuni aytadi.
explanation_en: The claim compares July and January: 12 is three times 4.

passage:
Share of respondents who use their phones more than 4 hours per day

Age 13–15 — 46%
Age 16–18 — 58%
Age 25–40 — 31%

Researchers surveyed teenagers and adults about their phone use. The survey found that teenagers were more likely than adults to use their phones heavily: ______
stem: Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
choices: 31% of adults aged 25–40 used their phones more than 4 hours per day.
46% of 13–15-year-olds and 58% of 16–18-year-olds reported using their phones more than 4 hours a day, compared with 31% of adults aged 25–40.
16–18-year-olds used their phones more than 13–15-year-olds did.
most respondents in every age group used their phones more than 4 hours a day.
explanation_uz: O'smirlarni kattalar bilan solishtirish kerak — B ikkala o'smir guruhi va kattalar ko'rsatkichini beradi. D noto'g'ri (kattalarda 31%).
explanation_en: B compares both teen groups with adults; D is false (only 31% of adults).

passage: Glass made in one ancient workshop region contains an unusual trace element that comes from the local sand. Archaeologists recently found glass beads containing the same trace element in a burial site about 2,000 kilometers away. No sand containing this element has been found near the burial site. This suggests that ______
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
choices: the people at the burial site made the beads themselves using local sand.
the trace element is common in sand around the world.
the beads were probably made in the workshop region and transported over a long distance.
glass beads were not valued by the people at the burial site.
explanation_uz: Element faqat ustaxona hududidagi qumda bor, dafn joyi yonida yo'q → munchoqlar o'sha yerda yasalib, uzoqqa olib kelingan.
explanation_en: The element comes only from the workshop's sand, so the beads were likely made there and carried far.

passage: My cousin lives in ______ she works as a nurse at the regional hospital.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: "where she works ..." — qo'shimcha izoh, shahar nomidan keyin vergul bilan ajratiladi.
explanation_en: "Where she works ..." adds information about Namangan and is set off with a comma.

passage: At its spring concert, the orchestra performed works by three ______ Mozart, Tchaikovsky, and Mustafo Bafoyev.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ikki nuqta ro'yxatni (uchta bastakor) kiritadi.
explanation_en: A colon introduces the list of three composers.

passage: The athlete trained for six ______ then, in her first international race, she broke the national record.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ikki mustaqil gap: nuqtali vergul ularni ajratadi. Faqat vergul — comma splice.
explanation_en: Two independent clauses need a semicolon; a comma alone is a comma splice.

passage: The museum's newest ______ a collection of handwritten letters from the 1920s—opens to the public on Friday.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Izoh tire bilan yopilgan, demak tire bilan ochilishi kerak.
explanation_en: The interruption closes with a dash, so it must open with one.

passage: The box of old family photographs ______ in the attic for decades before anyone opened it.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ega — "The box" (birlik), voqea o'tmishda: sat.
explanation_en: The subject is "box" and the context is past: "sat."

passage: The scientists published ______ findings in a peer-reviewed journal last spring.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: "The scientists" — ko'plik, egalik olmoshi: their.
explanation_en: "Scientists" is plural, so the possessive is "their."

passage: To reduce food waste, ______
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
choices: unsold meals are now donated by the cafeteria to a local shelter.
a local shelter now receives unsold meals from the cafeteria.
the school cafeteria now donates unsold meals to a local shelter.
donating unsold meals to a local shelter is now done by the cafeteria.
explanation_uz: Isrofni kim kamaytirmoqchi? Oshxona. Vergul ortidan "the school cafeteria" kelishi kerak.
explanation_en: The cafeteria is the one reducing waste, so it must follow the comma.

passage: Olive trees can live for hundreds of years. ______ some olive trees in the Mediterranean region are believed to be more than 2,000 years old.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Ikkinchi gap birinchisini kuchaytiradi: yuzlab yil emas, hatto 2 000 yil. "In fact".
explanation_en: The second sentence strengthens the first: "In fact."

passage: The town's old textile mill closed in 1995. ______ the building stood empty for nearly twenty years before being converted into apartments.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Voqealar ketma-ketligi: yopildi → keyin bo'sh turdi. "Afterward".
explanation_en: A time sequence: closed, then stood empty: "Afterward."

passage: Raising the highway speed limit was expected to shorten travel times. ______ average travel times barely changed, because faster traffic led to more frequent slowdowns near exits.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Nazariyada (kutilgan) va amalda (o'zgarmagan) — "In practice" — amalda esa.
explanation_en: Expectation vs. what actually happened: "In practice."

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The Kalyan Minaret stands in the center of Bukhara.
• It was built in 1127.
• It is about 46 meters tall.
• Its brick surface is decorated with bands of geometric patterns.
stem: The student wants to emphasize the minaret's age. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: The Kalyan Minaret, which stands in the center of Bukhara, is about 46 meters tall.
The Kalyan Minaret's brick surface is decorated with geometric patterns.
Built in 1127, the Kalyan Minaret in Bukhara is nearly 900 years old.
Bukhara's Kalyan Minaret is decorated with bands of patterns.
explanation_uz: Maqsad — yoshini ta'kidlash. C qurilgan yil (1127) va yoshini (deyarli 900 yil) aytadi.
explanation_en: C gives the year built and its age.

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Apricot and cherry trees are both widely grown in the Fergana Valley.
• Apricot trees bloom in early spring.
• Cherry trees bloom slightly later than apricot trees.
• Dried apricots from the region are exported to many countries.
stem: The student wants to contrast the blooming times of the two trees. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Apricot trees bloom in early spring, slightly earlier than cherry trees do.
Both apricot and cherry trees are widely grown in the Fergana Valley.
Dried apricots from the Fergana Valley are exported to many countries.
Cherry trees are grown in the Fergana Valley.
explanation_uz: Maqsad — gullash vaqtini qarama-qarshi qo'yish. A ikkalasini solishtiradi.
explanation_en: Only A contrasts when the two trees bloom.

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• A qanat is an underground channel used to move water.
• Qanats carry water from mountain sources to dry plains.
• Because the water flows underground, less of it evaporates.
• Qanats were built in Iran and parts of Central Asia, where they are called karez.
stem: The student wants to explain the purpose of qanats. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Qanats were built in Iran and parts of Central Asia.
In Central Asia, qanats are called karez.
A qanat is a kind of underground channel.
Qanats are underground channels that carry water from mountain sources to dry plains while limiting evaporation.
explanation_uz: Maqsad — nima uchun kerakligini tushuntirish. D: suvni tog'dan quruq tekislikka olib boradi va bug'lanishni kamaytiradi.
explanation_en: D explains what qanats do and why: move water while limiting evaporation.

passage: The company's apology was widely seen as ______: it expressed regret in a single sentence but offered no explanation and no plan to keep the problem from happening again.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Bir gap, tushuntirish yo'q, reja yo'q — shunchaki rasmiyatchilik: "perfunctory".
explanation_en: A one-line apology with no substance is "perfunctory."

passage: Rather than ______ her critics, the architect invited them to tour the building and judge the design for themselves.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Tanqidchilarni e'tiborsiz qoldirish o'rniga ularni taklif qilgan: "dismiss".
explanation_en: Instead of brushing critics aside, she invited them: "dismiss."

passage: Ancient astronomers' predictions of eclipses were remarkably ______, often correct to within a few hours despite the lack of modern instruments.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Bir necha soat aniqlikda — juda aniq: "precise".
explanation_en: Accurate within hours means "precise."

passage: The recording studio's walls are lined with special panels that ______ echoes, so that the microphones capture only the direct sound of the singer's voice.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Mikrofon faqat to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ovozni yozishi uchun aks-sado susaytiriladi: "dampen".
explanation_en: To capture only direct sound, panels "dampen" echoes.

passage: In her paintings, artist Gulnora Yusupova places everyday objects—a chipped teapot, a bus ticket, a child's school notebook—at the center of enormous canvases, a format traditionally reserved for portraits of rulers and heroes. By giving ordinary things this kind of treatment, she invites viewers to reconsider what is worth remembering.
stem: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
choices: To describe the history of portrait painting
To argue that everyday objects are more beautiful than people
To explain how an artist uses a particular choice to encourage viewers to rethink what deserves attention
To compare the paintings of several contemporary artists
explanation_uz: Rassom oddiy narsalarni odatda hukmdorlarga ajratilgan katta polotnolarga qo'yadi — bu tomoshabinni nima muhimligi haqida o'ylashga undaydi.
explanation_en: The artist's choice of format pushes viewers to rethink what matters.

passage: Many people assume that recycling plastic is always good for the environment. In many cases, it is. Some plastics, however, require so much energy to collect, clean, and process that recycling them produces more carbon emissions than making new plastic would. Researchers therefore recommend focusing recycling efforts on the types of plastic for which the benefits are clearest.
stem: Which choice best describes the function of the third sentence in the overall structure of the text?
choices: It introduces a qualification to the idea presented in the first two sentences.
It provides an example that supports the first sentence.
It states the researchers' final recommendation.
It describes the history of plastic recycling.
explanation_uz: 1–2 gaplar: qayta ishlash odatda foydali. 3-gap "however" bilan istisno qo'shadi — ba'zi plastmassalarda unday emas.
explanation_en: Sentence 3 adds an exception ("however") to the general idea in sentences 1–2.

passage:
Text 1
Some educators argue that homework in primary school has little academic benefit. Young children, they note, show almost no improvement in test scores when they are assigned regular homework.

Text 2
A long-term study followed students from age seven to age fifteen. Homework had only a small direct effect on younger students' test scores. However, students who completed regular homework in primary school were more likely to have strong study habits as teenagers, and those habits predicted higher achievement in secondary school.
stem: Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the educators in Text 1?
choices: By arguing that homework greatly improves young children's test scores
By claiming that study habits are unrelated to achievement
By recommending that homework be eliminated in primary school
By agreeing that homework has limited immediate academic benefit for young children while suggesting it may have other, longer-term benefits
explanation_uz: 2-matn bir qismida rozi (darhol ta'siri kichik), lekin qo'shimcha qiladi: o'qish odatlari va keyingi yutuqlar.
explanation_en: Text 2 agrees on the small immediate effect but adds a long-term benefit through study habits.

passage: Many migrating birds navigate at night using the stars. Bright city lights can confuse them, drawing them into cities where they collide with buildings. In recent years, several cities have asked owners of tall buildings to turn off unnecessary lights during peak migration seasons. In one city, bird collisions fell by more than half in the first year of the program.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
choices: Birds that migrate at night are more intelligent than those that migrate by day.
Reducing artificial light at night can help protect migrating birds.
Most cities have banned tall buildings to protect birds.
Birds use the stars only during the spring migration.
explanation_uz: Muammo (yorug'lik qushlarni chalg'itadi) va yechim (chiroqlarni o'chirish → to'qnashuvlar ikki baravar kamaydi).
explanation_en: The text presents a problem (lights confuse birds) and a solution that cut collisions by half.

passage: Some cheesemakers in the mountains of France still age their cheese in natural caves. Unlike most buildings, the caves stay at nearly the same cool temperature all year, and the air inside remains very humid. These steady conditions allow the cheese to ripen slowly and evenly, which many cheesemakers believe gives it a richer flavor.
stem: According to the text, why do some cheesemakers age their cheese in caves?
choices: Because caves are cheaper to use than modern storage rooms
Because cheese aged in caves can be sold more quickly
Because caves keep temperature and humidity steady
Because the caves contain minerals that change the cheese's color
explanation_uz: Matnda: g'orlar yil bo'yi bir xil salqin va nam — shuning uchun pishloq bir tekis pishadi.
explanation_en: The text says caves keep a steady cool temperature and high humidity.

passage: In the poem "Letter to My Daughter," the speaker expresses the hope that her daughter will be braver than she herself was.
stem: Which quotation from the poem most effectively illustrates this hope?
choices: "Go where I was afraid to go; knock on the doors I passed."
"Your first steps were across the kitchen floor."
"The apricot tree you planted is taller than the roof now."
"I still keep your drawings in the blue folder."
explanation_uz: Ikki qism: qizi jasurroq bo'lsin + men qo'rqqanman. A: "Men qo'rqqan joyga bor; men o'tib ketgan eshiklarni tak-tak qil."
explanation_en: A asks the daughter to go where the speaker was afraid to go.

passage: A wildlife researcher claims that the decline of a songbird species in a region was caused by a pesticide that farmers began using in 2010.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the researcher's claim?
choices: The pesticide is harmful to several insect species.
The songbird population was larger in 2009 than in 2015.
Farmers in the region use the pesticide on most of their fields.
The songbird population began declining in 2002, eight years before the pesticide was introduced.
explanation_uz: Agar kamayish pestitsiddan 8 yil OLDIN boshlangan bo'lsa, pestitsid asosiy sabab bo'la olmaydi.
explanation_en: If the decline began eight years before the pesticide, the pesticide can't be the original cause.

passage:
Average monthly visits to three museums

History museum — 2022: 8,000 — 2023: 9,600
Art museum — 2022: 12,000 — 2023: 12,600
Science museum — 2022: 5,000 — 2023: 7,500

A city tourism report claims that the science museum had the largest percentage increase in visits from 2022 to 2023.
stem: Which choice best uses data from the table to support the report's claim?
choices: The art museum had the most visits in both years.
Visits to the science museum rose 50%, from 5,000 to 7,500, compared with increases of 20% for the history museum and 5% for the art museum.
The science museum had 7,500 monthly visits in 2023.
All three museums had more visits in 2023 than in 2022.
explanation_uz: "Eng katta foiz o'sishi" — uchala muzeyning foizini solishtirish kerak: 50%, 20%, 5%.
explanation_en: A percentage comparison across all three is needed: 50% vs. 20% vs. 5%.

passage:
Food bank volunteers

2021 — 150 volunteers — 3,000 total hours
2023 — 120 volunteers — 3,600 total hours

A local newspaper reported on volunteering at the city food bank. Although the number of volunteers at the food bank fell between 2021 and 2023, ______
stem: Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
choices: the food bank had 150 volunteers in 2021.
the total number of hours volunteered rose from 3,000 to 3,600.
most volunteers worked at the food bank for more than one year.
explanation_uz: "Although" — ko'ngillilar kamaydi, LEKIN... — qarama-qarshi fakt: umumiy soatlar ko'paygan.
explanation_en: "Although" needs a contrasting fact: total hours went up.

passage: A species of sea snail living in rocky tide pools closes its shell tightly at low tide, when the pools are exposed to air. Researchers moved some of these snails to tanks in which the water level never changed. For several weeks, the snails continued to close their shells at the times when low tide would have occurred on the shore. This suggests that ______
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
choices: the snails have an internal rhythm that tracks the timing of tides, at least for a while after they are removed from the shore.
the water in the tanks was colder than the water in the tide pools.
the snails close their shells only when they are exposed to air.
the snails cannot survive outside tide pools.
explanation_uz: Tankda suv sathi o'zgarmagan, lekin salyangozlar baribir "past suv" vaqtida yopilgan → ichki ritm bor.
explanation_en: With no tide in the tanks, they still closed on schedule, so they must have an internal tidal rhythm.

passage: The novel's two narrators—a retired teacher and her teenage ______ tell the same story from very different points of view.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Izoh tire bilan ochilgan ("narrators—"), tire bilan yopilishi kerak.
explanation_en: The interruption opens with a dash, so it closes with one.

passage: The city survey asked residents a simple question: How often do you use public ______
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ikki nuqtadan keyin to'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol keladi, u so'roq belgisi bilan tugaydi.
explanation_en: The colon introduces a direct question, which ends with a question mark.

passage: The Fergana Valley, which is surrounded by mountains on three ______ is one of the most densely populated regions in Central Asia.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: "which is surrounded ... sides" izohi vergul bilan boshlangan — vergul bilan yopiladi.
explanation_en: The clause opened with a comma, so it closes with one.

passage: Before the race, each runner received a numbered ______ a timing chip that recorded split times.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: "a numbered bib and a timing chip" — bitta fe'lning ikkita to'ldiruvchisi, ular orasida tinish belgisi kerak emas.
explanation_en: Two objects of one verb joined by "and" need no punctuation.

passage: Neither of the proposed designs ______ the committee's requirements for cost and safety.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ega — "Neither" (birlik). Fe'l: meets.
explanation_en: "Neither" is singular, so "meets."

passage: The researchers found that the bats in the colony, which numbers in the thousands, ______ their roost each night at nearly the same time.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: "that" dan keyingi gapda ega — "the bats" (ko'plik). "which numbers in the thousands" — izoh. Fe'l: leave.
explanation_en: The subject of the clause is "bats" (plural); the inserted clause doesn't change it: "leave."

passage: In 1969, the year that astronauts first walked on the Moon, the town ______ its first public library.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: 1969-yil — aniq o'tgan vaqt: opened.
explanation_en: A specific past year calls for simple past: "opened."

passage: Some critics praised the film's long, quiet scenes as beautiful. ______ others complained that the slow pace made the story difficult to follow.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Ba'zilari maqtagan, boshqalari shikoyat qilgan — qarama-qarshi fikrlar: "By contrast".
explanation_en: Praise vs. complaint: "By contrast."

passage: When the new metro line opens, trains will run every 15 minutes. ______ once more trains are delivered, the city plans to increase service to every 5 minutes.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Avval 15 daqiqada, keyinroq 5 daqiqada — kelajakdagi bosqich: "Eventually".
explanation_en: A later stage in time: "Eventually."

passage: Most spiders catch their prey in webs that they rebuild regularly. The bolas spider, ______ does not spin a web at all; instead, it swings a single sticky thread to catch passing moths.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Ko'pchilik o'rgimchaklar to'r to'qiydi, bolas o'rgimchagi esa to'qimaydi — qarama-qarshilik.
explanation_en: The bolas spider is unlike most spiders: "by contrast."

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Ibn Sina, known in Europe as Avicenna, was born near Bukhara around 980.
• He wrote The Canon of Medicine, a large encyclopedia of medical knowledge.
• The Canon was translated into Latin in the twelfth century.
• It was used as a textbook in European universities for centuries.
stem: The student wants to emphasize the long-lasting influence of Ibn Sina's work. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Ibn Sina was born near Bukhara around 980.
Ibn Sina's Canon of Medicine was used as a textbook in European universities for centuries.
Ibn Sina is known in Europe as Avicenna.
The Canon of Medicine is a large encyclopedia of medical knowledge.
explanation_uz: Maqsad — uzoq davom etgan ta'sir. B: asrlar davomida Yevropa universitetlarida darslik bo'lgan.
explanation_en: B shows influence lasting centuries.

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Researchers measured noise levels in 50 classrooms.
• They compared students' reading test scores across the classrooms.
• Students in quieter classrooms scored 8% higher on average than students in noisier classrooms.
• The difference appeared at every grade level studied.
stem: The student wants to present the study's main finding. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Researchers measured noise levels in 50 classrooms.
The researchers compared reading test scores.
Noise levels were measured at every grade level.
In a study of 50 classrooms, students in quieter rooms scored 8% higher on reading tests, on average, than students in noisier rooms.
explanation_uz: Asosiy natija — tinch sinflarda ball 8% yuqori. D buni aytadi; A va B — usul.
explanation_en: D states the main finding; A and B describe the method.

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Adobe bricks are made of mud and straw.
• The bricks are dried in the sun rather than baked in a kiln.
• Thick adobe walls absorb heat during the day and release it slowly at night.
• This helps keep buildings comfortable in desert climates, where days are hot and nights are cold.
stem: The student wants to explain why adobe is useful in desert construction. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Because thick adobe walls absorb heat during the day and release it at night, adobe helps keep buildings comfortable in desert climates.
Adobe bricks are made of mud and straw and dried in the sun.
In deserts, days are hot and nights are cold.
Adobe bricks are not baked in a kiln.
explanation_uz: Maqsad — nima uchun foydali. A sababni (issiqlikni yutib, kechasi chiqaradi) va natijani (qulay) bog'laydi.
explanation_en: A links the property (absorbing and releasing heat) to the benefit (comfort).

stem: If 6x − 4 = 2x + 12, what is the value of x?
The function f is defined by f(x) = 5x + 2. For what value of x does f(x) = 27?
If 3(x − 4) = 9, what is the value of x?
The water in a kettle is 15°C and its temperature rises by 3°C each minute after the kettle is turned on. Which equation gives the temperature T, in °C, after m minutes?
explanation_uz: Boshlang'ich 15, har daqiqa +3: T = 15 + 3m.
explanation_en: Start at 15 and add 3 each minute: T = 15 + 3m.

stem: Which ordered pair (x, y) satisfies both y < 2x + 1 and y > −x?
explanation_uz: (1, 2): 2 < 3 ✓ va 2 > −1 ✓. Boshqalari kamida bitta shartni buzadi.
explanation_en: (1, 2): 2 < 3 and 2 > −1. The others fail a condition.

stem:
5x + 2y = 20
5x − 2y = 0

What is the value of y in the solution to the system above?
explanation_uz: Birinchisidan ikkinchisini ayiramiz: 4y = 20 → y = 5.
explanation_en: Subtract: 4y = 20, so y = 5.

stem: Which equation defines the line that passes through (4, 1) and is parallel to the line y = −2x + 7?
explanation_uz: Parallel → qiyalik −2. 1 = −8 + b → b = 9: y = −2x + 9.
explanation_en: Parallel means slope −2; 1 = −2(4) + b gives b = 9.

stem: A concert sold 200 tickets for a total of $6,350. Section A tickets cost $25 each and section B tickets cost $40 each. How many section B tickets were sold?
Which expression is equivalent to (3x²)(4x³)?
explanation_uz: Koeffitsientlar ko'paytiriladi (3 · 4 = 12), darajalar qo'shiladi (2 + 3 = 5): 12x⁵.
explanation_en: Multiply coefficients (12) and add exponents (5): 12x⁵.

stem:
x² = 3x + 10

What is the positive solution to the equation above?
explanation_en: (x − 5)(x + 2) = 0; the positive solution is 5.

stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = 3(2)^x. What is the value of f(0)?
Which expression is equivalent to x² − 25?
explanation_uz: Kvadratlar ayirmasi: a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b).
explanation_en: Difference of squares: (x − 5)(x + 5).

stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = x² − 4x. If f(a) = 12 and a > 0, what is the value of a?
explanation_en: a² − 4a − 12 = 0 gives a = 6 (a > 0).

stem:
y = x² − 6x + 8
y = 2x − 7

At how many points do the graphs of the equations above intersect in the xy-plane?
explanation_uz: Tenglaymiz: x² − 8x + 15 = 0 → (x − 3)(x − 5) = 0. Ikkita yechim → 2 nuqta.
explanation_en: x² − 8x + 15 = 0 has two solutions (3 and 5): 2 points.

stem: Which expression is equivalent to (x² + 5x + 6)/(x + 2) for x ≠ −2?
explanation_uz: x² + 5x + 6 = (x + 2)(x + 3), (x + 2) qisqaradi: x + 3.
explanation_en: Factor: (x + 2)(x + 3); cancel to get x + 3.

stem: A bag contains 24 red marbles and 16 blue marbles. What is the ratio of red marbles to the total number of marbles?
explanation_en: Total is 40; 24:40 = 3:5. (3:2 is red to blue.)

stem: A bicycle is priced at $250. A sales tax of 8% is added to the price. What is the total cost, in dollars?
The mean of a set of 7 test scores is 80. If a new score of 80 is added to the set, how does the mean of the 8 scores compare with the original mean?
explanation_uz: O'rtachaga teng qiymat qo'shilsa, o'rtacha o'zgarmaydi: (560 + 80) / 8 = 80.
explanation_en: Adding a value equal to the mean leaves it unchanged: 640/8 = 80.

stem: In a lab, 3 out of every 20 seeds of a certain plant fail to sprout. If 640 of these seeds are planted, about how many are expected to sprout?
explanation_uz: Unib chiqadi: 17/20 qismi. 640 · 17/20 = 544. (96 — unmaydiganlar.)
explanation_en: 17/20 sprout: 640 × 17/20 = 544. (96 is the number that fail.)

stem: A circle has a diameter of 10. What is the area of the circle?
explanation_uz: Radius 5, yuza πr² = 25π. (100π — diametrni radius deb olish xatosi.)
explanation_en: r = 5, area = 25π.

stem: A rectangular box has dimensions 4 centimeters by 5 centimeters by 6 centimeters. What is the volume of the box, in cubic centimeters?
In right triangle ABC, angle C measures 90°, AC = 5, and BC = 12. What is the value of tan A?
explanation_uz: tan A = A ga qarama-qarshi katet / yopishgan katet = BC / AC = 12/5.
explanation_en: tan A = opposite/adjacent = BC/AC = 12/5.

stem: If 7 − 3(x − 2) = 1, what is the value of x?
The equation C = 0.75m + 40 gives the cost C, in dollars, of renting a van for one day and driving it m miles. If the cost was $100, how many miles was the van driven?

2x − 3y = 7
4x + 3y = 23

What is the value of x in the solution to the system above?
explanation_uz: Qo'shamiz: 6x = 30 → x = 5.
explanation_en: Add: 6x = 30, so x = 5.

stem:
kx + 6y = 3
2x + 3y = 9

In the system of equations above, k is a constant. For what value of k does the system have no solution?

explanation_en: Proportional coefficients: k/2 = 6/3 gives k = 4, and 3/9 ≠ 2, so no solution.

stem: A line passes through the points (−1, 4) and (3, −8). Which of the following points does NOT lie on the line?
explanation_uz: Qiyalik −12/4 = −3, y = −3x + 1. x = −2 da y = 7, 6 emas.
explanation_en: The line is y = −3x + 1; at x = −2, y = 7, not 6.

stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = ax + 5, where a is a constant. If f(3) = 17, what is the value of f(−2)?
Which inequality represents the statement "a number x decreased by 4 is at most three times the number"?
explanation_uz: "x decreased by 4" = x − 4, "at most" = ≤, "three times the number" = 3x.
explanation_en: x − 4, "at most" (≤), 3x.

stem: What is the vertex of the graph of y = x² + 10x + 21 in the xy-plane?
If 9^x = 27, what is the value of x?
When the polynomial p(x) is divided by x − 3, the remainder is 0. Which of the following must be true?
explanation_uz: Qoldiq teoremasi: x − 3 ga bo'lganda qoldiq p(3). Qoldiq 0 → p(3) = 0.
explanation_en: By the remainder theorem, the remainder is p(3), so p(3) = 0.

stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = 2x² − 8. Which of the following is a zero of f?
explanation_uz: 2x² − 8 = 0 → x² = 4 → x = ±2. Variantlarda 2 bor.

stem: The graph of y = (x − 4)² + k in the xy-plane passes through the point (6, 9). What is the value of k?

Town A has 10,000 residents and its population grows by 500 people each year. Town B also has 10,000 residents and its population grows by 5% each year. Which statement about the populations 10 years from now is true?
choices: Town A will have more residents.
Town B will have more residents.
Both towns will have the same number of residents.
There is not enough information to compare them.
explanation_uz: A: 10 000 + 10 · 500 = 15 000. B: 10 000 · 1.05¹⁰ ≈ 16 289. Birinchi yili teng, keyin eksponensial o'sish oldinga chiqadi.
explanation_en: A: 15,000. B: 10,000 × 1.05¹⁰ ≈ 16,289. Exponential growth pulls ahead.

stem: If x² − y² = 48 and x + y = 8, what is the value of x − y?

The mean age of 50 survey participants was recorded as 34. It was later discovered that one participant's age had been entered as 84 instead of the correct age, 48. What is the correct mean age of the participants?
explanation_uz: Yig'indi 84 − 48 = 36 ga kamayadi. O'rtacha 36 / 50 = 0.72 ga kamayadi: 34 − 0.72 = 33.28.
explanation_en: The sum drops by 36, so the mean drops by 36/50 = 0.72: 33.28.

stem: A train travels 180 kilometers in 2 hours 15 minutes. What is the train's average speed, in kilometers per hour?
explanation_uz: 2 soat 15 daqiqa = 2.25 soat. 180 / 2.25 = 80.

stem: The price of a jacket was increased by 20%. Later, the new price was decreased by 25%. What is the overall change from the original price?

Researchers randomly assigned 200 adult volunteers either to follow a new diet or to continue their usual diet for 12 weeks. On average, the volunteers on the new diet lost significantly more weight. Which conclusion is best supported by the study?
choices: The new diet causes weight loss for all people of every age.
The new diet is the best diet available.
Volunteers chose the diet that suited them best.
The new diet likely causes greater weight loss for adults similar to those in the study.
explanation_uz: Tasodifiy taqsimlash → sabab haqida xulosa mumkin, lekin faqat shunga o'xshash kattalar uchun. A haddan tashqari umumlashtiradi.
explanation_en: Random assignment supports a causal conclusion, but only for people similar to the volunteers.

stem: The data set 2, 4, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11 is changed by replacing 11 with 30. Which statistic does NOT change?
explanation_uz: Eng katta qiymat o'zgarsa ham o'rtadagi qiymat (5) o'sha joyda qoladi. Qolganlari o'zgaradi.
explanation_en: The middle value stays 5; the others change.

stem: In a circle with center O and radius 10, a sector has a central angle of 72°. What is the area of the sector?
explanation_en: 72° is 1/5 of the circle: 100π/5 = 20π.

stem: A triangle has sides of length 7, 24, and 25. What is the area of the triangle?
explanation_en: 7² + 24² = 25², so it's a right triangle: area = (7 × 24)/2 = 84.

stem: What is the midpoint of the segment joining the points (−3, 2) and (5, −4) in the xy-plane?

passage: The puppy was so ______ that it chased every leaf that blew across the yard.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Har bir bargning ortidan quvgan — o'yinqaroq: "playful".
explanation_en: Chasing every leaf shows the puppy is "playful."

passage: The documentary offers a ______ view of the city, showing not only its famous landmarks but also its crowded markets, quiet courtyards, and busy bus stations.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: "not only ... but also ..." — shaharning ko'p tomonlari ko'rsatilgan: har tomonlama, "comprehensive".
explanation_en: It shows many sides of the city: "comprehensive."

passage: Some medicines must be taken with food because, on an empty stomach, they can ______ the lining of the stomach.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Ovqat bilan ichish kerak, chunki aks holda zarar beradi: "irritate" — ta'sirlantiradi.
explanation_en: They must be taken with food because otherwise they harm the stomach: "irritate."

passage: Critics found the novel's ending ______: after three hundred pages of mystery, the author resolves every remaining question in a single short paragraph.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: 300 sahifa sir, keyin bitta qisqa xatboshida hammasi hal bo'ladi — keskin, kutilmagan: "abrupt".
explanation_en: Resolving everything in one short paragraph is "abrupt."

passage: Many people think of ants as simple insects. Leafcutter ants, however, practice a form of farming. They cut pieces of leaves not to eat them but to carry them underground, where they use the leaves to grow a fungus. The ants then feed on the fungus, carefully tending it and removing any harmful molds.
stem: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
choices: To describe a complex behavior in an insect that people might consider simple
To argue that ants are more intelligent than other insects
To explain why leaves are important to forests
To compare different species of ants
explanation_uz: Matn: odamlar chumolilarni oddiy deb o'ylaydi, "however" — barg kesuvchi chumolilar dehqonchilik qiladi (murakkab xatti-harakat).
explanation_en: It contrasts the "simple" view of ants with leafcutters' complex farming.

passage: Why does cutting an onion make people cry? When an onion is sliced, damaged cells release enzymes that turn certain compounds into a gas. When this gas reaches the eyes, it reacts with their moisture and irritates them, triggering tears. Chilling an onion slows this reaction, which is why some cooks refrigerate onions for half an hour before cutting them.
stem: Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
choices: It describes an experiment and then explains why its results were surprising.
It presents two competing explanations and argues for one of them.
It compares onions with other vegetables that irritate the eyes.
It poses a question, explains the answer, and then describes a practical use of that explanation.
explanation_uz: Savol (nega yig'laymiz?) → tushuntirish (gaz ko'zni ta'sirlantiradi) → amaliy qo'llanish (piyozni sovutish).
explanation_en: Question, then explanation, then a practical tip based on it.

passage:
Text 1
Some museum curators argue that important artifacts should remain in major museums, where specialists can protect them from damage and scholars from around the world can study them.

Text 2
There is a growing movement to return artifacts to the communities they came from. Supporters point out that, when returned, such objects can again play a role in living traditions and ceremonies. Several communities have also built their own climate-controlled facilities and trained local conservators to care for returned objects.
stem: Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the curators' concern about protecting artifacts?
choices: By agreeing that artifacts are safest in major museums
By arguing that scholars no longer need to study artifacts
By pointing out that some communities of origin are able to care for artifacts properly
By claiming that most artifacts are not damaged by travel
explanation_uz: Kuratorlarning tashvishi — himoya. 2-matn: ba'zi jamoalar maxsus binolar qurib, restavratorlar tayyorlagan — ya'ni ular ham himoya qila oladi.
explanation_en: Text 2 notes communities have built facilities and trained conservators, answering the protection concern.

passage: During sleep, the brain does not simply rest. Researchers have found that it replays experiences from the day, strengthening the connections between brain cells that store new memories. In one study, students who slept for a few hours after studying a list of words remembered more of them the next day than students who stayed awake.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
choices: Students should study only in the evening.
The brain is completely inactive during sleep.
Lists of words are difficult to memorize.
Sleep plays an important role in helping people remember what they have learned.
explanation_uz: Matn: uyquda miya kunduzgi tajribani mustahkamlaydi; uxlagan talabalar ko'proq eslab qolgan. B esa matnga zid.
explanation_en: Both the brain research and the study show sleep helps memory; B contradicts the text.

passage: When the envelope from the conservatory finally arrived, Ziyoda carried it into the kitchen without opening it. She read only her name on the front, then set it face down on the table and began to make tea. She washed the cups twice and wiped the counter, which was already clean. Only after her tea had gone cold did she turn the envelope over again.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
choices: Ziyoda is not interested in studying at the conservatory.
Ziyoda is nervous about what the letter will say and delays finding out.
Ziyoda has already been told the conservatory's decision.
explanation_uz: Konvertni ochmaydi, keraksiz ishlar qiladi (toza stolni artadi) — javobdan qo'rqib, kechiktiryapti.
explanation_en: She avoids opening it with pointless chores: she's nervous and delaying.

passage: In a speech to a regional business conference, engineer Laziz Hamidov argued that solar power has become an affordable choice for local companies.
stem: Which quotation from Hamidov's speech most effectively supports his argument?
choices: "Our region enjoys more than 300 sunny days each year."
"Solar panels must be cleaned regularly to work efficiently."
"Over the past decade, the cost of installing solar panels in our region has fallen by more than 80 percent."
"Many companies are interested in protecting the environment."
explanation_uz: Da'vo — ARZON bo'lgani. Faqat C narx haqida: narx 80% dan ko'proq tushgan. A — quyoshli kunlar, narx emas.
explanation_en: The claim is about affordability; only C addresses cost.

passage: Researchers hypothesize that young children learn new words more effectively when the words are taught together with hand gestures that illustrate their meaning.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers' hypothesis?
choices: Children taught new words with matching hand gestures recalled more of the words a week later than children taught the same words without gestures.
Children enjoyed lessons that included gestures more than lessons without them.
Teachers used gestures more often with younger children than with older children.
Some children learned new words faster than others.
explanation_uz: Gipoteza: imo-ishora → yaxshiroq o'rganish. A: bir xil so'zlar, imo-ishora bilan o'rganganlar ko'proq eslab qolgan.
explanation_en: A compares the same words with and without gestures and shows better recall with gestures.

passage:
Average price of tomatoes at a market (per kilogram)

January — $2.40
April — $1.80
July — $0.90
October — $1.50

A market reporter claims that tomato prices were lowest in summer.
stem: Which choice best uses data from the table to support the reporter's claim?
choices: Prices in October were lower than in January.
Prices fell to $0.90 per kilogram in July, the lowest of the months shown.
Prices in April were $1.80 per kilogram.
Tomatoes cost more than $1.00 per kilogram in January.
explanation_uz: Yoz oyi — iyul. B iyuldagi narx eng pasti ekanini aytadi.
explanation_en: July is the summer month, and B shows it had the lowest price.

passage:
Increase in crop yield with a new fertilizer, by soil type

Sandy soil — 22%
Loam — 11%
Clay — 6%

Agricultural researchers tested a new fertilizer on fields with different types of soil. They concluded that the fertilizer was most effective for ______
stem: Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the conclusion?
choices: plants grown in clay, which is common in the region.
all three types of soil equally.
plants grown in loam, where yields increased by 11%.
plants grown in sandy soil, where yields increased by 22%, compared with 11% in loam and 6% in clay.
explanation_uz: Eng samarali — eng katta o'sish: qumli tuproq, 22%. D uni boshqalar bilan solishtiradi.
explanation_en: The largest increase (22%) was in sandy soil; D compares it with the others.

passage: On island A, many birds hunt a certain species of lizard; on nearby island B, the lizards have no predators. Lizards on island A run faster and hide more quickly than those on island B. When researchers moved a group of lizards from island B to island A, the descendants of these lizards, within a few generations, also ran faster than their ancestors had. This suggests that ______
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
choices: lizards on island B are a different species from those on island A.
birds on island A prefer to hunt slower animals.
the presence of predators can lead to changes in the lizards' abilities over generations.
lizards cannot survive on islands that have predators.
explanation_uz: B dan A ga ko'chirilgan kaltakesaklarning avlodlari tezlashgan — yirtqichlar avloddan-avlodga o'zgarishga olib kelgan.
explanation_en: Moved lizards' descendants became faster on the predator island: predators drove the change.

passage: The recipe is ______ it requires only four ingredients and twenty minutes of cooking.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ikki nuqta "simple" ni tushuntiradi (nega oddiy). Vergul — comma splice, hech narsa — run-on.
explanation_en: A colon introduces the explanation of "simple"; a comma would be a comma splice.

passage: Visitors to the national park can choose from three ______ a guided walk, a bicycle tour, or a boat ride.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ikki nuqta ro'yxatni (uchta tur) kiritadi.
explanation_en: A colon introduces the list of tours.

passage: The ______ a two-stringed instrument with a long neck, is often played at weddings in Uzbekistan.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Izoh ("a two-stringed instrument ...") vergul bilan tugaydi, demak vergul bilan boshlanadi.
explanation_en: The appositive ends with a comma, so it must begin with one.

passage: The engineers' test results pointed to a single ______ the new bridge design's ability to withstand earthquakes stronger than any ever recorded in the region.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ikki nuqta "conclusion" nima ekanini tushuntiruvchi ot birikmani kiritadi. Nuqtali vergul ortidan to'liq gap kerak, bu yerda esa yo'q.
explanation_en: A colon introduces what the conclusion was; a semicolon would need a full independent clause after it.

passage: Every one of the apricot trees in the orchard ______ fruit this year, despite the late frost.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ega — "Every one" (birlik). "produced" birlik va ko'plikda bir xil, qolganlari ko'plik.
explanation_en: "Every one" is singular; "produced" works, while the others are plural.

passage: The national volleyball team ______ its first match of the season last Saturday.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: "last Saturday" — aniq o'tgan vaqt: won. (Present Perfect aniq o'tgan vaqt bilan ishlatilmaydi.)
explanation_en: A specific past time ("last Saturday") takes simple past: "won."

passage: The results of the survey, which was conducted in three cities, ______ surprising to many researchers.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Ega — "The results" (ko'plik), "survey" emas. Fe'l: were.
explanation_en: The subject is "results" (plural): "were."

passage: The library's old building had no elevator. ______ visitors who used wheelchairs could not reach the second floor.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Lift yo'q → natijada nogironlar ikkinchi qavatga chiqa olmagan. "As a result".
explanation_en: No elevator caused the problem: "As a result."

passage: Most of the city's buses run on diesel fuel. ______ ten new electric buses began service on the busiest routes this month.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Ko'pchilik dizel, LEKIN yangi elektr avtobuslar — zidlik: "However".
explanation_en: Diesel buses vs. new electric ones: "However."

passage: The architect first built a small model of the tower and tested its stability in a wind tunnel. ______ she revised the design, making the base of the tower wider.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Sinov → natijaga ko'ra loyihani o'zgartirgan. "Based on the results".
explanation_en: The test results led to the revision: "Based on the results."

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Aydarkul is a large lake in the Kyzylkum Desert of Uzbekistan.
• It formed in 1969, when floodwater from the Syr Darya river was released into a desert depression.
• Today the lake covers more than 3,000 square kilometers.
• It is popular with visitors who stay in yurt camps and watch birds.
stem: The student wants to explain how Aydarkul was formed. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Aydarkul, in the Kyzylkum Desert, covers more than 3,000 square kilometers.
Aydarkul is popular with visitors who stay in yurt camps.
Many birds can be seen at Aydarkul.
Aydarkul formed in 1969, when floodwater from the Syr Darya river was released into a desert depression.
explanation_uz: Maqsad — qanday hosil bo'lgani. D: 1969-yil Sirdaryo toshqin suvi cho'l chuqurligiga oqizilgan.
explanation_en: Only D explains how the lake formed.

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The Hubble Space Telescope was launched in 1990.
• Its main mirror is 2.4 meters wide.
• The James Webb Space Telescope was launched in 2021.
• Its main mirror is 6.5 meters wide.
stem: The student wants to emphasize a difference in size between the two telescopes. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: The Hubble Space Telescope was launched in 1990, and the James Webb Space Telescope was launched in 2021.
The James Webb Space Telescope's 6.5-meter mirror is nearly three times as wide as Hubble's 2.4-meter mirror.
The James Webb Space Telescope has a main mirror.
Hubble was launched more than thirty years before Webb.
explanation_uz: Maqsad — o'lchamdagi farq. B ko'zgularni solishtiradi: 6.5 m va 2.4 m.
explanation_en: B compares the mirror sizes; A and D compare launch dates.

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Nigora Tursunova is a soil scientist at a university in Samarkand.
• She discovered a bacterium that helps wheat grow in salty soil.
• In field trials, wheat treated with the bacterium produced 18% more grain.
• Salty soil is a major problem for farmers in parts of Central Asia.
stem: The student wants to introduce Tursunova and her discovery to an audience unfamiliar with her. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Soil scientist Nigora Tursunova discovered a bacterium that helps wheat grow in salty soil.
Salty soil is a major problem in parts of Central Asia.
In field trials, treated wheat produced 18% more grain.
Nigora Tursunova works at a university in Samarkand.
explanation_uz: Tanishtirish: kim (tuproqshunos) va nima kashf qilgan. A ikkalasini aytadi.
explanation_en: A gives both who she is and what she discovered.

passage: The professor's lectures were famously ______, wandering from topic to topic in ways that delighted some students and frustrated others.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Mavzudan mavzuga o'tib ketadi — chalg'iydigan: "digressive".
explanation_en: Wandering from topic to topic is "digressive."

passage: The treaty's language was deliberately ______, allowing each side to interpret its key terms in whatever way best suited its own interests.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Har tomon o'zicha talqin qila olgan — ataylab noaniq: "ambiguous".
explanation_en: Terms open to different interpretations are "ambiguous."

passage: Though she was ______ about her own role in the discovery, her colleagues insisted that the breakthrough would not have happened without her.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: "Though" — zidlik: o'zi rolini kamtarona baholagan, hamkasblari esa uni asosiy deb bilgan: "modest".
explanation_en: "Though" contrasts her view with her colleagues' praise: she was "modest."

passage: The researchers ______ their earlier estimate, lowering the predicted rise in sea level after new satellite data became available.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation_uz: Yangi ma'lumot asosida bashoratni pasaytirishgan — qayta ko'rib chiqishgan: "revised".
explanation_en: Lowering the estimate after new data is to "revise" it.

passage: In my grandmother's house, nothing was thrown away. Bread crusts became soup; old dresses became quilts; empty jam jars became drinking glasses. As a child, I found these habits embarrassing. Now, when I see how much my own household discards each week, I understand them as a kind of wisdom.
stem: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
choices: To show how the narrator's view of her grandmother's habits has changed over time
To give instructions for reusing household items
To describe the narrator's childhood home in detail
To criticize the grandmother for being too careful with money
explanation_uz: Bolaligida — uyat, hozir — donolik. Matn qarashning o'zgarishini ko'rsatadi.
explanation_en: Embarrassment as a child, wisdom now: her view changed.

passage: Honeybees communicate the location of food through a "waggle dance": the angle of the dance shows the direction relative to the sun, and its length shows the distance. For decades, however, some scientists doubted that other bees actually used this information to find food. Experiments in which bees were tracked by radar showed that bees that had watched a dance flew almost directly toward the location it indicated.
stem: Which choice best describes the function of the last sentence in the overall structure of the text?
choices: It describes the history of research on bee dances.
It introduces a doubt that the rest of the text supports.
It presents evidence that resolves the doubt mentioned in the previous sentence.
explanation_uz: Oldingi gap: olimlar shubha qilgan. Oxirgi gap: radar tajribasi arilar raqsdagi ma'lumotdan foydalanishini ko'rsatgan — shubhani hal qiladi.
explanation_en: The last sentence gives radar evidence that answers the doubt in the sentence before it.

passage:
Text 1
Some paleontologists have argued that Tyrannosaurus rex was mainly a scavenger, feeding on animals that were already dead. They point to its tiny arms, which would have been of little use in grabbing prey.

Text 2
Other researchers note that T. rex had forward-facing eyes that gave it excellent depth perception, a trait common in predators. Moreover, fossils of plant-eating dinosaurs have been found with T. rex bite marks that later healed, showing that the animals were bitten while alive and survived the attack.
stem: Based on the texts, how would the researchers in Text 2 most likely respond to the argument in Text 1?
choices: By agreeing that T. rex's arms were too small to be useful
By presenting evidence that T. rex attacked living prey, contrary to the argument in Text 1
By claiming that plant-eating dinosaurs were also scavengers
By arguing that T. rex's eyesight was poor
explanation_uz: 1-matn: asosan o'limtik yegan. 2-matn: tirik hayvonlarda bitgan tishlash izlari → T. rex tirik o'ljaga hujum qilgan.
explanation_en: Healed bite marks show T. rex attacked living animals, countering the scavenger argument.

passage: Some species of bamboo can grow nearly a meter in a single day, and because bamboo regrows from its roots after it is cut, it can be harvested repeatedly without replanting. Its stems are also remarkably strong for their weight. For these reasons, some builders are using bamboo as an alternative to wood and steel. Untreated bamboo, however, is easily damaged by insects and moisture, so it must be carefully treated before it can be used in long-lasting buildings.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
choices: Most builders have stopped using wood.
Bamboo grows only in wet climates.
Bamboo has several qualities that make it a promising building material, though it requires treatment to last.
explanation_uz: Ijobiy tomonlar (tez o'sadi, qayta ekish shart emas, mustahkam) va bitta shart (ishlov berish kerak). D ikkalasini qamraydi.
explanation_en: D captures both the advantages and the need for treatment.

passage: A team of engineering students designed a solar-powered boat to cross Lake Issyk-Kul. Larger batteries would have stored more energy for cloudy periods, but each additional battery added weight, and the team's tests showed that a heavier boat moved much more slowly. The students therefore chose smaller batteries and planned their crossing for a week with a sunny forecast.
stem: According to the text, why did the students choose smaller batteries?
choices: Because heavier batteries would have slowed the boat
Because larger batteries were too expensive
Because the lake was too small for a large boat
Because solar panels cannot charge large batteries
explanation_uz: Matnda: har bir qo'shimcha batareya og'irlik qo'shgan, og'irroq qayiq esa sekinroq yurgan.
explanation_en: The text says extra batteries added weight, and a heavier boat was much slower.

passage: In the novel The Two Roads, the main character, Shahlo, is torn between staying in her village and moving to the city.
stem: Which quotation from The Two Roads most effectively illustrates Shahlo's situation?
choices: "Shahlo had lived in the village all her life."
"Each morning she packed her suitcase, and each evening she unpacked it again."
"The city was four hours away by bus."
"Her mother made the best plov in the village."
explanation_uz: Ikkilanish: har tong chamadonni yig'adi, har kech yana ochadi — qaror qila olmaydi.
explanation_en: Packing and unpacking every day shows she can't decide.

passage: Historians studying an ancient city claim that its underground water system was built before its defensive walls.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the historians' claim?
choices: The walls were made of stone, while the water pipes were made of clay.
The water system supplied water to more than half of the city's houses.
Sections of the water pipes had been cut through and rerouted so that the walls' foundations could be laid.
The walls were repaired several times over the city's history.
explanation_uz: Devor poydevori uchun quvurlarni kesishga to'g'ri kelgan bo'lsa, quvurlar devordan OLDIN mavjud bo'lgan.
explanation_en: If pipes had to be cut to lay the walls' foundations, the pipes came first.

passage:
Share of households with internet access

Region 1 — 2015: 40% — 2025: 85%
Region 2 — 2015: 65% — 2025: 90%
Region 3 — 2015: 30% — 2025: 78%

A report on digital access claims that the gap between regions with the most and least internet access narrowed between 2015 and 2025.
stem: Which choice best uses data from the table to support the report's claim?
choices: In 2015, access ranged from 30% to 65%, a gap of 35 percentage points, but by 2025 it ranged from 78% to 90%, a gap of only 12 points.
Region 2 had the highest access in both years.
explanation_uz: Farqning qisqarishini ko'rsatish uchun ikkala yildagi farqni solishtirish kerak: 35 → 12.
explanation_en: A compares the gap in both years: 35 points vs. 12.

passage:
Participation in after-school clubs

2020 — girls: 54% — boys: 47%
2024 — girls: 61% — boys: 52%

A school district tracked students' participation in after-school clubs. The data show that ______
stem: Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
choices: participation fell for both girls and boys between 2020 and 2024.
boys participated more than girls in 2024.
in both years, a larger share of girls than boys took part, with 54% versus 47% in 2020 and 61% versus 52% in 2024.
more than half of all students participated in 2020.
explanation_uz: C jadvalni to'g'ri o'qiydi. A va B jadvalga zid. D noaniq: umumiy ulush ma'lum emas (qizlar va o'g'il bolalar soni berilmagan).
explanation_en: C reads the table correctly; A and B contradict it, and D can't be determined.

passage: Many moths can hear the high-pitched calls that bats use to locate prey, and they dive or dodge when they detect them. Researchers found that one bat species produces calls at a frequency that a common local moth cannot hear. This suggests that ______
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
choices: this bat species does not eat moths.
the moth cannot hear any sounds at all.
bats in general are unable to catch moths.
the moth may be less able to avoid this bat species than bats whose calls it can hear.
explanation_uz: Kuya ko'rshapalakni eshitib qochadi. Bu turning chaqiruvini eshitmasa, undan qochish qiyinroq.
explanation_en: If the moth can't hear this bat's calls, it can't dodge it as well.

passage: Kamila's research on desert ______ which she began as an undergraduate, has now spanned more than fifteen years.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Izoh vergul bilan tugaydi ("undergraduate,") — vergul bilan boshlanishi kerak.
explanation_en: The clause ends with a comma, so it starts with one.

passage: The committee will announce the ______ first, second, and third places—at the closing ceremony.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Izoh tire bilan yopilgan, tire bilan ochilishi kerak.
explanation_en: The interruption ends with a dash, so it begins with one.

passage: Why did the ancient builders choose this ______ are still debating that question.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: Birinchi gap to'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol — so'roq belgisi bilan tugaydi, keyingi gap bosh harf bilan boshlanadi.
explanation_en: The direct question ends with "?", and the new sentence starts with a capital letter.

passage: In the 1930s, the photographer traveled across Central ______ documenting markets, caravans, and village festivals.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: "documenting ..." — asosiy gapga qo'shilgan sifatdosh oborot, vergul bilan ajratiladi.
explanation_en: The participial phrase "documenting ..." is set off with a comma.

passage: Every student and teacher in the school ______ invited to the opening of the new science wing.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: "Every" bilan boshlangan qo'shma ega birlikda qaraladi: was.
explanation_en: "Every" makes the compound subject singular: "was."

passage: After a long discussion, the committee members still could not agree on how to spend ______ budget.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation_uz: "The committee members" — ko'plik: their.
explanation_en: "Members" is plural: "their."

passage: Exhausted after the long climb, ______
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
choices: the stream was a welcome place to rest.
resting beside the stream was a relief.
the hikers rested beside the stream.
a rest beside the stream was taken by the hikers.
explanation_uz: Kim charchagan? Sayyohlar. Vergul ortidan "the hikers" kelishi kerak.
explanation_en: The hikers were exhausted, so they must follow the comma.

passage: The two theories make very different predictions about how the comet's tail should behave as it nears the sun. ______ observations of the comet next spring may help scientists determine which theory is correct.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Nazariyalar turlicha bashorat qiladi → shuning uchun kuzatuv qaysi biri to'g'riligini ko'rsatadi.
explanation_en: Because the predictions differ, observations can decide between them: "Consequently."

passage: Early maps of the region showed a large lake in the north. ______ later explorers found only a dry salt flat in that location.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Xaritada ko'l bor, haqiqatda esa quruq sho'rxok — zidlik: "However".
explanation_en: The maps and the reality conflict: "However."

passage: Most mammals lose the ability to digest milk after they are weaned. Some human populations, ______ have a genetic trait that allows adults to digest milk throughout their lives.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation_uz: Ko'pchilik sutemizuvchilar va ba'zi odamlar qarama-qarshi qo'yilgan: "however".
explanation_en: Some humans differ from most mammals: "however."

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The Registan is the central square of Samarkand.
• It is framed by three madrasas.

stem: The student wants to emphasize that the madrasas of the Registan were built over a long period. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: The Registan, the central square of Samarkand, is framed by three madrasas.
The three madrasas of the Registan were built over more than two centuries, from the Ulugh Beg Madrasa in the 1410s to the Tilya-Kori Madrasa, completed around 1660.
The Sher-Dor Madrasa was built in the 1620s and 1630s.
The Tilya-Kori Madrasa is one of three madrasas in the Registan.
explanation_uz: Maqsad — uzoq davr. B birinchi (1410-lar) va oxirgi (1660) madrasalarni ko'rsatib, ikki asrdan ortiq vaqtni ta'kidlaydi.
explanation_en: B spans the first and last madrasas, showing more than two centuries.

passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Researchers tested a reading app with 120 students.
• All of the students attended schools in one city.
• After six weeks, the students' reading scores rose by 10% on average.
• The researchers noted that the results might not apply to students in other regions.
stem: The student wants to present a limitation of the study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: After six weeks of using the app, students' reading scores rose by 10% on average.
Researchers tested a reading app with 120 students.
The reading app was used for six weeks.
Because the study included only 120 students from one city, its results might not apply to students elsewhere.
explanation_uz: Cheklov — tadqiqotning zaif tomoni. D: faqat bir shahardan 120 o'quvchi, natijalar boshqa joylarga mos kelmasligi mumkin.
explanation_en: D states the limitation: a small sample from one city.

stem: The student wants to compare the densities of the two metals. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

Aluminum is widely used to build aircraft, and steel is generally stronger.
Steel is generally stronger than aluminum.
Aluminum has a density of about 2.7 grams per cubic centimeter.

What is the y-intercept of the graph of y = −3x + 8 in the xy-plane?

stem: If x/3 − 2 = 5, what is the value of x?
A streaming service charges a one-time setup fee of $30 plus $12 per month. What is the total cost, in dollars, of using the service for 9 months?
Which inequality describes all values of x that satisfy 2x − 7 ≥ 5?

x + y = 9
3x + y = 21

explanation_en: Subtract: 2x = 12, x = 6, so y = 3.

stem: For a linear function f, f(1) = 4 and f(5) = 16. Which equation defines f?
explanation_en: Slope = 12/4 = 3; 4 = 3(1) + b gives b = 1.

stem: In the xy-plane, the lines y = 2x + 3 and y = kx − 1 never intersect. What is the value of k?
explanation_uz: Kesishmaydi → parallel → qiyaliklar teng: k = 2 (ozod hadlar 3 va −1 har xil).
explanation_en: Never intersecting means parallel: k = 2.

stem: Which expression is equivalent to (x + 4)²?
explanation_uz: (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² → x² + 8x + 16. (x² + 16 — keng tarqalgan xato.)

stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = (x − 2)(x + 7). What are the x-intercepts of the graph of y = f(x)?
explanation_uz: Har bir ko'paytuvchini nolga tenglaymiz: x = 2 va x = −7.
explanation_en: Set each factor to zero: x = 2 and x = −7.

stem: If 2^x = 32, what is the value of 2^(x + 1)?
A colony of 50 bacteria doubles in size every hour. Which function gives the number of bacteria, B, after h hours?
explanation_uz: Boshlang'ich 50, har soat 2 ga ko'payadi: 50 · 2^h.
explanation_en: Start at 50 and multiply by 2 each hour: 50(2)^h.

stem:
x² − 10x + c = 0

In the equation above, c is a constant. If the equation has exactly one real solution, what is the value of c?
explanation_uz: Diskriminant 0: 100 − 4c = 0 → c = 25. (x − 5)² = 0.

stem: If (x + 3)/(x − 1) = 3, what is the value of x?
Which function has a graph in the xy-plane that opens downward and has its vertex at (2, 5)?
explanation_uz: Pastga ochiladi → a < 0. Uch (2, 5) → −(x − 2)² + 5.
explanation_en: Opens downward (negative), vertex (2, 5): −(x − 2)² + 5.

stem: 40% of a number is 18. What is the number?
A cyclist rides at a constant speed of 18 kilometers per hour. How many minutes does it take the cyclist to ride 6 kilometers?
explanation_uz: 6 / 18 = 1/3 soat = 20 daqiqa.
explanation_en: 6/18 hour = 1/3 hour = 20 minutes.

stem: What is the mode of the data set 3, 7, 7, 2, 9, 7, 3?
explanation_uz: Eng ko'p takrorlangan qiymat: 7 (3 marta).
explanation_en: 7 appears most often (3 times).

stem: In a survey of 80 people, 50 said they prefer tea to coffee. Of the people who prefer tea, 30 are women. Of the people who do not prefer tea, 12 are women. If one of the women surveyed is chosen at random, what is the probability that she prefers tea?
explanation_uz: Ayollar jami: 30 + 12 = 42. Ulardan choy afzal ko'radiganlar 30: 30/42 = 5/7.
explanation_en: Women total 42; 30 prefer tea: 30/42 = 5/7.

stem: A triangle has a base of 10 and a height of 7. What is the area of the triangle?
A circle has a circumference of 18π. What is the radius of the circle?
explanation_en: 2πr = 18π, so r = 9.

stem: In a right triangle, A is an acute angle and cos A = 8/17. What is the value of sin A?
explanation_uz: Yopishgan katet 8, gipotenuza 17 → qarama-qarshi katet √(289 − 64) = 15. sin A = 15/17.
explanation_en: Adjacent 8, hypotenuse 17, so opposite = 15; sin A = 15/17.

stem: If x/2 + x/3 = 10, what is the value of x?
explanation_uz: Umumiy maxraj 6: 3x/6 + 2x/6 = 5x/6 = 10 → x = 12.

stem: The line y = mx − 4 passes through the point (3, 5) in the xy-plane. What is the value of m?

3x + 2y = 10
6x + 4y = c

In the system above, c is a constant. For what value of c does the system have infinitely many solutions?
explanation_uz: Ikkinchi tenglama birinchisining 2 baravari bo'lishi kerak: c = 2 · 10 = 20.
explanation_en: The second equation must be twice the first: c = 20.

stem: Gym A charges a $50 joining fee plus $20 per month. Gym B charges $35 per month with no joining fee. After how many full months will the total cost at Gym A first be less than the total cost at Gym B?
explanation_uz: 50 + 20m < 35m → 50 < 15m → m > 3.33. Birinchi butun oy: 4.
explanation_en: 50 + 20m < 35m gives m > 3.33, so 4 months.

stem: For a linear relationship, y = 7 when x = 0, y = 3 when x = 2, and y = −1 when x = 4. Which equation represents this relationship?
explanation_uz: Qiyalik (3 − 7) / 2 = −2, y-kesishma 7: y = −2x + 7.
explanation_en: Slope = −4/2 = −2; intercept 7.

stem: If 5 − 2(3 − x) = x + 4, what is the value of x?
Which statement is true about the graph of 2y − 6x = 8 in the xy-plane?
choices: It has a slope of 3 and a y-intercept of 4.
It has a slope of 6 and a y-intercept of 8.
It has a slope of −3 and a y-intercept of 4.
It has a slope of 3 and a y-intercept of 8.
explanation_en: Solve for y: y = 3x + 4.

stem: For x > 0, which expression is equivalent to (x^(1/2))⁶?
explanation_uz: Daraja darajaga ko'tarilganda ko'paytiriladi: (1/2) · 6 = 3.
explanation_en: Multiply exponents: (1/2)(6) = 3.

stem: The function p is defined by p(x) = x² + bx − 12, where b is a constant. If p(3) = 0, what is the value of b?
A ball is dropped from a height of 80 meters. Its height h, in meters, t seconds after it is dropped is given by h = 80 − 5t². After how many seconds does the ball hit the ground?
Which statement best describes the graph of y = 3(0.5)^x in the xy-plane?
choices: It is increasing and has a y-intercept of 3.
It is decreasing and has a y-intercept of 3.
It is decreasing and has a y-intercept of 0.5.

stem:
x⁴ − 13x² + 36 = 0

What is the sum of all positive solutions to the equation above?
explanation_uz: u = x²: u² − 13u + 36 = 0 → u = 4 yoki 9 → x = 2 yoki 3 (musbat). Yig'indi 5.
explanation_en: Let u = x²: u = 4 or 9, so positive x = 2 and 3; sum 5.

stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = x² − 2x − 8. For which values of x is f(x) < 0?
explanation_uz: Ildizlar −2 va 4. Parabola yuqoriga ochiladi, demak ildizlar orasida manfiy.
explanation_en: Roots −2 and 4; an upward parabola is negative between them.

stem: Which expression is equivalent to (3x − 2)(x + 5) − 3x²?
explanation_en: Expand and subtract 3x²: 13x − 10.

stem: A store marks up the cost of a lamp by 40% and sells it for $84. What was the store's cost for the lamp?
The mean of seven numbers is 10. When one of the numbers is removed, the mean of the remaining six numbers is 9. What number was removed?
explanation_uz: Yig'indi 70 edi, endi 54. Olib tashlangan: 70 − 54 = 16.

stem: A car's value decreases linearly from $24,000 when new to $15,000 after 6 years. What is the car's value after 4 years?
explanation_en: It loses 1,500 per year; after 4 years: 24,000 − 6,000 = 18,000.

stem: A researcher surveyed 300 members of a city's gyms and found that 80% of them exercise at least three times a week. Why is it NOT appropriate to conclude that 80% of all adults in the city exercise at least three times a week?
choices: The sample size of 300 is too large.
The survey asked only about exercise.
Some gym members may not have answered.
The sample was not representative of all adults in the city.

Two right circular cylinders are similar. The radius of the smaller cylinder is 3 and the radius of the larger cylinder is 6. What is the ratio of the volume of the smaller cylinder to the volume of the larger cylinder?
explanation_uz: O'xshashlik koeffitsienti 2. Hajmlar nisbati koeffitsientning kubi: 2³ = 8 → 1:8.
